recommendation.en: Skim the state-estimation view of caching; it has little direct signal for LLM pretraining but is useful side knowledge for diffusion serving.

paper.title: P-MTP: Efficient Document Parsing via Multi-Token Prediction with Progressive Depth Scaling
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have revolutionized document parsing by enabling end-to-end mapping from images to structured text, imposing a significant latency bottleneck, particularly for token-dense documents. While Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has emerged as a promising approach for accelerating inference, its potential is constrained by optimization instability when scaling to deeper look-ahead depth. In this paper, we propose \textbf{P-MTP}, a framework that leverages \textbf{Progressive M

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是文档解析 VLM 的一个很具体但也很现实的问题：输出序列很长，标准自回归解码一步只出一个 token，延迟高；而直接把 LLM 里的 multi-token prediction 套到文档解析上，又会在 look-ahead 深度变大时出现训练不稳和推理接受率下降。更细一点看，问题不只是“多预测几个 token 难”，而是远端 supervision 会在近端 token 已经错掉时继续回传梯度，造成错误轨迹上的噪声学习；同时固定深度 speculative drafting 也无法适应文档中不同区域的难度差异，简单区域浪费潜在加速，复杂区域则频繁 reject。论文的目标就是让 MTP 在文档解析这种 token-dense、视觉证据强约束的场景里，能把 look-ahead 深度真正做深，同时保持可训练、可接受、可落地。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是在改预训练范式，但对“训练目标如何服务高吞吐生成”有直接启发。第一，论文说明了在高确定性生成任务里，MTP 的瓶颈不只是模块设计，而是 loss 如何根据轨迹可靠性分配监督，这和预训练里 long-horizon target、any-order target、multi-step target 的稳定优化是同一类问题。第二，它把训练时的 trajectory-aware weighting 和推理时的 dynamic drafting 配成一套闭环，说明仅靠 inference trick 不够，训练目标必须显式建模 acceptance dynamics。第三，文档解析虽然是 VLM 任务，但其输出端是标准 LM 生成，很多观察可以迁移到代码生成、结构化抽取、OCR-heavy agent 这类高置信度 token generation 场景。贡献量级更像是“把已有 MTP 思路在一个高价值场景里做对”，不是新范式，但方法设计有一定普适性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心有两部分。第一部分是 Progressive Curriculum Loss，用来解决深 look-ahead 训练不稳。论文不是对所有深度 k 的预测一视同仁地加权，而是给每个位置 t、每个深度 k 一个自适应权重 ω_{t,k}。这个权重由两类约束组成：Sequential Confidence Constraint 和 Retrospective Target Constraint。前者利用前面各层 look-ahead 预测的 softmax 置信度做累计约束，近似衡量“走到第 k 步这条路径是否还可信”；如果前面某一步已经低置信或偏离，后面更远的 supervision 会被压低。这样做的直接作用，是避免 distal target 在 proximal prediction 已经失败时继续制造 hallucinated gradients。后者则从回顾式目标一致性角度再做一次筛选，抑制那些和真实目标轨迹不一致的远端监督。两者叠加后，loss 会自然形成 easy-to-hard 的课程学习：先学稳近端，再逐步放开远端。

第二部分是 Confidence-Gated Dynamic Drafting，用于推理阶段动态决定实际 draft 多深。传统 MTP 常用固定 K，但固定 K 在文档解析里明显不合适，因为表格、公式、纯文本段落的局部熵差异很大。P-MTP 在每一步根据累计联合置信度判断是否继续向更深处 draft：如果前几步 token 的联合概率仍高，就继续扩展；一旦累计可靠性跌破阈值，就提前截断。这样优化的是 αK 而不是单独追求大 K，其中 α 是接受率。论文还强调 MTP module 需要足够轻量，否则额外前向开销 γ 会吃掉加速收益，因此他们采用 shared lightweight MTP module 递归地产生多个 look-ahead token，而不是为每个深度堆重头分支。

和已有方法相比，区别主要有三点。其一，不再使用 constant 或 static-decay loss weighting，而是显式让 loss 感知 trajectory divergence。其二，不再把 drafting depth 当成固定超参，而是把它做成基于置信度的在线决策。其三，场景上利用了文档解析“视觉证据强、输出分布尖锐”的特性，说明 MTP 在这类任务里比开放域文本生成更有条件做深 look-ahead。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可以确认，论文报告的主结果是：在文档解析任务上，P-MTP 在几乎不损失解析精度的前提下，推理加速最高可到 5×。作者把这个结果归因于两点同时成立：训练阶段更深的 look-ahead 可以稳定学出来，推理阶段动态 drafting 又能把简单样本上的潜在接受长度真正兑现出来。

实验结构上，值得注意的应当包括几类。第一类是与标准 NTP、自带固定深度 MTP、不同静态 loss weighting 策略的对比，用来证明 progressive weighting 的必要性。第二类是 look-ahead 深度 K 的扩展实验，通常会展示随着 K 增大，基线方法 acceptance rate 明显下降，而 P-MTP 能把更深 K 维持在可用区间。第三类是动态 drafting 的消融，验证固定 K 即便训练得住，也会因为场景难度波动而损失 αK。第四类是模块开销分析，轻量 MTP 分支的额外 overhead γ 需要足够低，否则理论 speedup 不能转成 wall-clock gain。

目前可从正文直接提取的硬数字主要是“up to 5× speedup with negligible impact on parsing accuracy”。摘要截断，没有完整 benchmark 表、参数量、训练数据规模、具体 acceptance rate 和不同 K 下的曲线数字。如果精读原文，建议重点补齐：1）主干 VLM 规模；2）MTP module 参数占比；3）不同 K 的接受率 α；4）真实吞吐提升而非仅 token/s；5）在表格、公式、长文段等不同文档类型上的收益差异。这些数字决定方法是工程上可复用，还是只在特定设置下成立。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但方法部分要读细。优先看 Introduction 里 Figure 1，对训练不稳和固定深度 drafting 低效的两个问题定义得比较清楚。然后直接看 Method 里 Progressive Curriculum Loss 的公式，重点确认 ω_{t,k} 的具体构成：累计置信度怎么计算，是否 stop-gradient，Retrospective Target Constraint 具体依赖 teacher target、accepted path 还是模型自身历史输出。这里决定它究竟是一个稳健的 credit assignment 机制，还是经验性 reweighting。

接着看 Confidence-Gated Dynamic Drafting 的算法描述和伪代码，关注阈值如何设、是否需要额外校准、不同深度共享不共享 hidden state。再看实验部分的三张关键图表：1）不同 K 下的训练稳定性或 loss 曲线；2）接受率/加速比随深度变化；3）精度-延迟 trade-off。若时间有限，30-40 分钟足够抓住主线；若想判断它对通用 LM 训练有没有启发，需要额外看 supplementary 里的 speedup 推导和失败案例，尤其是复杂布局下动态截断是否只是保守回退到浅层 MTP。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in document-parsing VLMs: decoding is slow because outputs are long and standard autoregressive generation emits one token per step. Multi-token prediction is an obvious acceleration route, but pushing the look-ahead depth deeper causes two coupled failures in this setting. During training, distal supervision becomes noisy once proximal predictions have already diverged, so deeper targets inject gradients along unreliable trajectories. During inference, a fixed drafting depth is a poor fit because document regions vary a lot in local difficulty: easy spans could support deeper drafting, while hard spans trigger frequent rejection. The paper tries to make deep MTP actually usable for token-dense document parsing, not just theoretically appealing.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers because it isolates a general optimization issue: how to supervise multi-step predictions when later targets are only meaningful if earlier ones remain reliable. That same issue appears in long-horizon target design, speculative objectives, and broader non-standard LM training setups. A second useful point is that the paper treats training and inference as a coupled system: better acceptance at inference requires a trajectory-aware loss during training, not only a decoding heuristic. The contribution is best read as a solid adaptation of MTP to a high-value structured generation setting, with lessons that may transfer to code generation, OCR-heavy generation, and other high-confidence token prediction regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. The first is Progressive Curriculum Loss, designed to stabilize deep look-ahead training. Instead of assigning a constant or hand-decayed weight to every prediction depth k at position t, the model uses an adaptive weight ω_{t,k}. This weight combines two constraints. The Sequential Confidence Constraint uses the softmax confidence of preceding look-ahead predictions to estimate whether the trajectory up to depth k is still trustworthy. If an earlier step is already uncertain or off-track, supervision for deeper predictions is down-weighted. This suppresses the classic failure mode where distal targets keep backpropagating through a path that has already collapsed. The Retrospective Target Constraint adds another filter based on consistency with the target trajectory, further reducing noisy supervision from unreliable deep predictions. Together, these terms create an implicit easy-to-hard curriculum: the model first learns stable short-horizon prediction and only gradually receives stronger supervision on deeper horizons.

The second component is Confidence-Gated Dynamic Drafting for inference. Standard MTP usually fixes the drafting depth K, but fixed K is suboptimal for document parsing because entropy varies sharply across layouts, tables, formulas, and plain text spans. P-MTP instead decides online how far to draft based on cumulative joint confidence. If the predicted path remains reliable, the model keeps extending the draft; if confidence drops below a threshold, it truncates early. This directly optimizes the useful quantity αK, where α is the acceptance rate, rather than maximizing K in isolation. The paper also keeps the MTP branch lightweight, using a shared module that recurrently produces multiple look-ahead predictions, so the extra overhead γ stays small enough for real wall-clock gains.

Relative to prior MTP work, the main differences are: trajectory-aware loss weighting instead of static weighting, adaptive drafting depth instead of fixed-depth drafting, and an explicit exploitation of the document-parsing regime where visual evidence makes token distributions sharper than in open-ended text generation.
summary_en.experiments:
From the full text provided, the main empirical claim is clear: P-MTP reaches up to 5× inference speedup on document parsing with negligible accuracy loss. The paper attributes this to the combination of stable deep look-ahead training and adaptive drafting at inference, rather than either component alone.

The most important experiments are likely organized around four questions. First, comparisons against standard next-token prediction, vanilla fixed-depth MTP, and static loss-weighting variants, to show that progressive weighting is necessary. Second, scaling studies over look-ahead depth K, where baseline MTP should show collapsing acceptance as K grows, while P-MTP remains usable at deeper horizons. Third, ablations on dynamic drafting, showing that even if a model can be trained with deep K, a fixed K still wastes speedup because local difficulty varies. Fourth, overhead analysis of the lightweight MTP module, since theoretical speedup only matters if the extra branch cost remains low.

The hard numbers visible in the provided text are limited to 'up to 5× speedup with negligible impact on parsing accuracy.' The excerpt does not include full benchmark tables, model size, training scale, acceptance-rate curves, or detailed latency breakdowns. When reading the original paper, the most important missing numbers to extract are: backbone VLM size, parameter share of the MTP module, acceptance rate α at different K, wall-clock throughput rather than token-level proxy metrics, and gains across different document types such as tables, formulas, and long text blocks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim-level paper, but the method section deserves careful attention. Start with Figure 1 in the introduction, because it frames the two real problems cleanly: unstable deep supervision and inefficiency of fixed-depth drafting. Then go straight to the formulas for Progressive Curriculum Loss. The key questions are how cumulative confidence is computed, whether gradients are stopped through the weighting path, and what exactly the retrospective consistency term compares against. Those details determine whether the method is a principled credit-assignment mechanism or mostly a heuristic reweighting trick.

Next, read the algorithm for Confidence-Gated Dynamic Drafting and check how thresholds are chosen, whether calibration is needed, and how hidden states are reused across depths. In the experiments, focus on three plots or tables if available: training stability versus depth, acceptance/speedup versus depth, and the accuracy-latency trade-off. Around 30-40 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If the goal is to judge transferability to general LM training, also inspect the supplementary derivation of speedup and any failure cases on complex layouts, especially whether the dynamic policy often falls back to shallow drafting in hard regions.

recommendation.zh: 将 MTP 扩展到更深深度的训练 trick，其 Progressive Curriculum Loss 对稳定 MTP 训练有启发，值得看方法部分。
recommendation.en: Training tricks for scaling MTP to deeper depths; its Progressive Curriculum Loss is instructive for stabilizing MTP training. Worth reading the method section.

paper.title: SSD: Spatially Speculative Decoding Accelerates Autoregressive Image Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive models excel in visual generation by treating images as 1D sequences of discrete tokens, mirroring language modeling. However, this flattening discards the intrinsic 2D spatial locality of visual signals, creating severe computational bottlenecks during inference. We introduce Spatially Speculative Decoding (SSD), a framework that aligns the predictive objective with the natural geometry of images. Rather than predicting only the immediate next token in a 1D sequence, our model si

summary.core_problem: 自回归图像生成将2D图像展平为1D token序列执行next-token预测，丢弃了固有空间局部性，生成单张图像需数千次串行前向传播，内存带宽瓶颈（内存墙）突出；现有直接迁移自NLP的推测解码方法受限于1D序列假设，草稿接受率低，加速幅度有限。
summary.importance: 为统一自回归多模态模型提供了无需改动预训练骨干的插拔式推理加速方案；同时明确了多模态统一建模的一项取舍：预训练阶段采用1D序列实现跨模态共享建模的同时，推理阶段可利用模态固有几何结构恢复效率，且不破坏预训练能力；该思路也可为多模态token的预测策略设计提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案是空间推测解码（SSD）：打破1D序列草稿预测思路，利用raster扫描顺序中当前位置的垂直相邻（正下方）token与水平相邻token的预测依赖强度相近的特性，沿水平、垂直轴并行预测整行候选token。预测头采用轻量结构，挂载于预训练骨干最后一层RMSNorm之前的连续隐层特征上——而非直接预测离散视觉token，因离散视觉token概率分布平坦，学习信号不稳定，连续特征的训练信号更稳定。验证阶段放弃严格二值拒绝策略，改用软修正：利用骨干的前向传播输出自动修正微小表征偏差，未解决的不一致可通过额外前向传播处理。整个模块与现有预训练自回归视觉骨干完全兼容。
summary.experiments: 在三个主流高性能自回归图像/多模态模型上完成测试：Lumina-mGPT上的wall-clock加速比达12.19倍，Janus-Pro上为5.74倍，Emu3上最高达13.28倍。接受率统计显示，垂直+1位置的预测接受率为30.32%，与水平+1位置的43.27%接近，验证了2D空间依赖假设的合理性。预测头的FLOPs开销极低，即使单步草稿生成240个token，额外开销仍可忽略。
summary.reading_guide: 先查看Figure1、Figure2的2D空间依赖与解码流程示意，理解核心直觉；再阅读方法部分的两项关键设计：采用RMSNorm前连续特征训练预测头、用软验证机制替代硬拒绝；最后查看不同骨干模型的加速比结果表格。预计阅读时间20-25分钟，无需深入细粒度实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive visual generation flattens 2D images into 1D token sequences for next-token prediction, discarding inherent spatial locality. Generating one image requires thousands of serial forward passes, leading to a severe memory bandwidth bottleneck (memory wall). Existing speculative decoding methods migrated from NLP are constrained by the 1D sequential assumption, resulting in low draft acceptance rates and limited speedups for visual generation.
summary_en.importance: It provides a plug-and-play inference acceleration scheme for unified autoregressive multimodal models, requiring no modification to pretrained backbones. It also clarifies a key tradeoff in multimodal unified modeling: while 1D sequence formulation enables shared modeling across modalities during pretraining, modality-specific geometric structure can be leveraged at inference to recover efficiency without breaking pretrained capabilities. This logic can also inform the design of multimodal token prediction strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Spatially Speculative Decoding (SSD) breaks from 1D sequential drafting. It exploits the fact that, in raster-scan order, a token’s vertical neighbor (directly below) has predictive dependency comparable to its immediate horizontal neighbor, so it drafts entire rows of candidate tokens in parallel across horizontal and vertical axes. Lightweight prediction heads are attached to the continuous hidden features before the final RMSNorm of the pretrained backbone, rather than predicting discrete visual tokens directly — discrete visual tokens have flat probability distributions with unstable learning signals, while continuous features provide more stable supervision. During verification, strict binary rejection is replaced with soft correction: the backbone’s forward pass output auto-fixes minor representational mismatches, and unresolved discrepancies can be handled with additional forward passes. The entire module is fully compatible with existing pretrained autoregressive visual backbones.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three widely adopted high-performance autoregressive visual/multimodal models: 12.19× wall-clock speedup on Lumina-mGPT, 5.74× on Janus-Pro, and up to 13.28× on Emu3. Acceptance rate measurements confirm that the vertical +1 position has 30.32% acceptance, close to the 43.27% of the horizontal +1 position, validating the 2D spatial dependency assumption. The drafting heads introduce negligible FLOPs overhead, even when generating 240 draft tokens per step.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Figures 1 and 2 to grasp the core intuition of 2D spatial dependency and decoding flow. Then review two key design choices in the Method section: the use of pre-RMSNorm continuous features for draft head training, and the soft verification mechanism instead of hard rejection. Finally, check the speedup result tables across different backbones. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes; no need to dive into fine-grained implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 把推测解码从1D文本扩展到2D视觉token的思路很有启发，重点看§3的空间推测规则设计和§4的加速比拆解
recommendation.en: The idea of extending speculative decoding from 1D text to 2D visual tokens is inspiring, focus on §3 for spatial speculation rule design and §4 for speedup breakdown.

paper.title: JetFlow: Breaking the Scaling Ceiling of Speculative Decoding with Parallel Tree Drafting
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them in parallel, but it faces a scaling limitation: increasing the draft budget improves speed only when acceptance remains high and drafting overhead stays low. This ceiling has been difficult to break because prior head-based SD methods face a causality-efficiency dilemma. Autoregressive drafters produce path-conditioned candidates that are effective for tree speculative

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 speculative decoding 在大 draft budget 下的扩展瓶颈：草稿 token 增多时，如果接受率下降或草稿生成成本上升，端到端加速很快失效。
summary.importance: 这篇论文主要属于推理效率和 serving 优化，但对预训练研究也有间接价值。它把多 token 预测、tree speculative decoding 和因果条件建模放在同一个问题里处理。对基座训练而言，值得关注的是：如果未来在预训练或 mid-training 中加入多 token prediction head，不能只追求并行预测多个位置，还要保证不同候选分支之间满足自回归因果条件。否则模型可能生成单点上看合理、组合起来不一致的候选树，导致验证预算浪费。
summary.technical_approach: JetFlow 的核心是 causal parallel tree drafting。已有 head-based speculative decoding 面临一个取舍：EAGLE 这类自回归 drafter 能生成 path-conditioned 候选，质量较好，但树深增加时需要更多顺序 draft pass；DFlash 这类双向 block-diffusion drafter 可以一遍生成多个位置，但每个位置更像 branch-agnostic marginal，候选之间可能互不一致。JetFlow 训练一个因果并行 draft head，在一次 forward 中预测多个树节点，同时通过 block-level causal attention over hidden states 保留分支内的路径条件。这样每个分支的 draft distribution 更接近目标模型的自回归分解，tree verification 时更容易利用更大的 draft token budget。论文还设计了相应的 tree-drafting 算法，并把方法接入工业级 serving engine 做真实负载评测。
summary.experiments: 在低 draft budget 场景下，使用 16 个 draft tokens 时，JetFlow 达到有竞争力的端到端加速。更关键的是高 budget 场景：使用 256 个 draft tokens 时，在 MATH-500 上达到 τ=10.7，并取得约 9.5 倍端到端加速；在 MT-Bench 上仍保持 τ=5.9，并取得超过 4 倍加速。论文还在不同请求率下接入 serving engine 测试，结果显示在小到中等负载下相对基线更有优势，在 B200 这类高端 GPU 上收益更明显。这里的关键信号不是单个 benchmark 的数字，而是 draft budget 扩大后接受长度仍能增长，说明并行草稿的因果一致性确实改善了预算利用率。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点看 Section 2 或方法开头关于 speculative decoding 加速公式的推导，它清楚说明了接受率 α、draft cost c 和 draft length N 的约束关系。随后看 JetFlow 的 causal parallel draft head 和 block-level causal attention 设计，特别是它如何区别于 EAGLE 的顺序路径建模和 DFlash 的并行但分支无关建模。实验部分优先看 draft budget 从 16 扩到 256 时的曲线，以及 serving engine 中不同 request rate 和 GPU 类型下的吞吐/延迟结果。预计阅读 30 到 40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a scaling ceiling in speculative decoding. Increasing the draft budget only helps when the acceptance rate stays high and the drafting overhead remains small. Existing head-based methods struggle to satisfy both conditions at large tree sizes.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference and serving paper, but it has useful implications for pretraining and mid-training designs that add multi-token prediction heads. The main lesson is that parallel prediction is not enough. A useful draft tree must preserve causal consistency along each branch. Otherwise, the model may produce tokens that are individually plausible but mutually inconsistent, wasting verification capacity and limiting speedup.
summary_en.technical_approach: JetFlow introduces causal parallel tree drafting. Prior head-based speculative decoding methods face a tradeoff. Autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE generate path-conditioned candidates, which improves acceptance, but drafting cost grows with tree depth. Bidirectional block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate many positions in one pass, but their branch-agnostic marginals can form inconsistent candidate trees. JetFlow trains a causal prediction head that predicts multiple tree nodes in a single forward pass while using block-level causal attention over hidden states to preserve branch-wise conditioning. This makes each branch closer to the target model’s autoregressive factorization. The paper also develops tree-drafting algorithms around this head and integrates the method into an industry-grade serving engine.
summary_en.experiments: With a small draft budget of 16 tokens, JetFlow reports competitive end-to-end speedups. The more informative setting is the large-budget regime. With 256 draft tokens, JetFlow reaches τ=10.7 and about 9.5x end-to-end speedup on MATH-500. On MT-Bench, it still reaches τ=5.9 and more than 4x speedup. The serving experiments evaluate different request rates and show stronger gains under small to moderate loads, with particularly clear benefits on higher-end GPUs such as B200. The key result is that the accepted length continues to scale when the draft budget increases, suggesting that causal branch conditioning improves budget utilization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the derivation of the speculative decoding speed model first, especially the roles of acceptance rate α, draft cost c, and draft length N. Then focus on the causal parallel draft head and the block-level causal attention mechanism. The most useful comparison is against EAGLE-style sequential path-conditioned drafting and DFlash-style one-pass but branch-agnostic drafting. In the experiments, prioritize the curves that scale the draft budget from 16 to 256 and the serving-engine results across request rates and GPU types. Expected reading time is about 30 to 40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和 speed/budget 曲线；若接受率随树宽稳定，值得在服务栈复现，不影响预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the method and speed-vs-budget curves; if acceptance stays stable with tree width, it is worth reproducing in serving, not in pretraining.

paper.title: MoECa: Aligning Feature Reuse with Expert Decomposition in Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts (DiT-MoE) improve model capacity under sparse activation, but diffusion inference is still bottlenecked by redundant computation across timesteps. Existing caching methods mainly operate at the token level, which becomes suboptimal in DiT-MoE because each token update is internally decomposed into multiple routed expert branches. Our analysis shows that cross-timestep redundancy in DiT-MoE is better characterized at the expert-branch level than at t

summary.core_problem: DiT-MoE的扩散推理在时间步之间存在冗余计算，现有token级缓存方法因每个token被路由到多个专家分支而不再最优。
summary.importance: 提出了一种在专家分支粒度上进行跨时间步特征复用的缓存框架MoECa，对DiT-MoE推理加速有实用价值。
summary.technical_approach: 分析发现DiT-MoE跨时间步冗余更适合在专家分支粒度刻画；提出MoECa，进行分支级特征重用，引入专家感知的自适应控制和跨MoE与attention路径的同步缓存更新以维持中间状态稳定。
summary.experiments: 在多个DiT-MoE模型上验证，相比已有缓存方法取得更好的速度-质量trade-off，最高2.83×推理加速。

summary_en.core_problem: DiT-MoE diffusion inference suffers from redundant computation across timesteps; existing token-level caching is suboptimal because each token is routed into multiple expert branches.
summary_en.importance: Proposes MoECa, a fine-grained caching framework that reuses features at the expert-branch level across timesteps, offering practical inference speedup for DiT-MoE models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Observes that cross-timestep redundancy in DiT-MoE is better characterized at expert-branch level; MoECa performs branch-level feature reuse with expert-aware adaptive control and synchronized cache updates across MoE and attention paths to maintain stable intermediate states.
summary_en.experiments: Consistent better speed-quality trade-off than prior caching methods across multiple DiT-MoE models, up to 2.83× inference speedup.

recommendation.zh: DiT-MoE推理效率工作，对扩散模型Serving有参考，LLM预训练研究员可只看摘要和实验表格。
recommendation.en: DiT-MoE inference efficiency work; relevant to diffusion serving but marginal for LLM pretrain; read abstract and experiment tables only.

paper.title: Training-free sparse attention based on cumulative energy filtering
paper.abstract: Sparse attention accelerates Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for video generation by computing only the important tokens while skipping the rest. The token selection strategy is key to balancing sparsity and accuracy. We formulate the token filtering process as a dual-goal optimization problem: maximizing sparsity and minimizing accuracy degradation. Existing algorithms cannot fulfill both objectives simultaneously. For example, Top-p only considers the accuracy constraint, while Top-k maintains a

summary.core_problem: 解决视频生成 Diffusion Transformer 推理中稠密 attention 成本高、现有稀疏 token 选择难以同时保证精度和计算节省的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的推理加速方法，面向 DiT 视频生成的 sparse attention；和 LLM 预训练不是同一主线，但对长序列 attention 稀疏化和 FlashAttention 集成有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将 token filtering 表述为同时最大化稀疏率、最小化精度损失的双目标问题；论文主张固定 recall rate 足以约束精度，而固定阈值会浪费计算，因此提出动态阈值策略，并和 FlashAttention 深度集成，避免额外 mask 计算开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频生成模型、分辨率、token 数、速度提升或质量指标；作者声称在相同精度水平下提高稀疏率，并通过 FlashAttention 集成消除额外 masking overhead。

summary_en.core_problem: Reduces the cost of dense attention in video-generation Diffusion Transformers, where existing sparse token-selection rules struggle to preserve quality while saving compute.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference acceleration method for DiT video generation. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but the sparse-attention criterion and FlashAttention integration are useful engineering signals for long-sequence systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates token filtering as a dual-objective problem: maximize sparsity while minimizing accuracy degradation. It argues that a fixed recall rate is enough to preserve accuracy, whereas a fixed threshold is compute-inefficient, then introduces dynamic thresholding integrated tightly with FlashAttention to avoid extra masking overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the exact video model, resolution, token count, speedup, or quality metrics. It claims higher sparsity at the same accuracy level and no additional masking overhead due to FlashAttention integration.

recommendation.zh: 只看动态阈值和 FA 集成细节即可；结论若成立，可作为长序列 attention 裁剪的弱工程信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the dynamic-thresholding and FlashAttention integration details; if the claim holds, it is a weak but useful signal for long-sequence attention pruning.

paper.title: Accelerating Speculative Diffusions via Block Verification
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up LLM inference by using a draft model to generate tokens, with an acceptance-rejection scheme that ensures that the output matches the target distribution. Adapting this to continuous diffusions is difficult because speculative sampling requires drawing from a residual distribution. While straightforward in discrete spaces, efficiently sampling this residual in continuous space is non-trivial. Consequently, existing diffusion adaptations either use computationally i

summary.core_problem: 解决连续扩散模型中 speculative sampling 难以高效实现 residual distribution 采样、因此难以复用 LLM block verification 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率方法。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对“如何把 AR 侧成熟的 speculative decoding 思想迁移到非 AR 生成范式”有参考价值，尤其对统一生成系统和 AR+diffusion 混合 serving 有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一种可在连续空间中高效实现原始 speculative sampling 机制的方案，使扩散模型也能进行 acceptance-rejection 校正并保持目标分布不变。在此基础上，把 LLM 中的 block verification 迁移到 diffusion，理论上提高 draft 接受率；同时形式化分析 Free Drafter 这一 self-speculative 启发式。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和加速倍数。实验应围绕与现有 diffusion speculative 方法比较采样效率、接受率和分布保真度，并验证 block verification 与 Free Drafter 的收益。没有看到与 LLM 本体训练或语言建模直接相关的实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Arnaud Doucet、Valentin De Bortoli，偏概率建模与扩散方向，方法论较扎实。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the difficulty of implementing speculative sampling in continuous diffusion models, where sampling from the residual distribution is non-trivial and prevents a clean transfer of LLM-style block verification.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution rather than an LLM pretraining paper. Its value for foundation-model researchers is mainly conceptual: how mature AR decoding ideas can be ported to non-AR generative paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a scheme that efficiently realizes the original speculative sampling mechanism in continuous diffusion spaces, preserving the target distribution through acceptance-rejection correction. This enables block verification for diffusion models, which is argued to improve draft acceptance rates. They also formalize and analyze the Free Drafter self-speculative heuristic.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, or speedup numbers. The likely evaluation compares against prior diffusion speculative methods on sampling efficiency, acceptance rate, and fidelity to the target distribution. There is no direct LLM-training experiment here.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Arnaud Doucet and Valentin De Bortoli, both well known in probabilistic modeling and diffusion-related research.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把 LLM speculative decoding 的 clean 机制搬到 diffusion 很工整；只看方法节和接受率分析，别指望它直接改你的训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly ports speculative-decoding machinery to diffusion; read the method and acceptance-rate analysis, not for training recipe changes.

paper.title: DiffusionGemma: 4x faster text generation

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型生成速度远低于自回归LM，难以落地实用
summary.importance: 顶尖实验室推出的可与AR速度竞争的扩散LM方案，属于文本建模范式的重要突破
summary.technical_approach: 基于Gemma基座改造扩散语言建模 pipeline 实现生成加速，具体技术细节暂未公开
summary.experiments: 公开宣称文本生成速度较原有扩散LM方案提升4倍，暂无详细评测数据
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind团队，具体作者信息未披露

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion language models have much lower generation speed than autoregressive LMs, hindering practical deployment
summary_en.importance: Key breakthrough in text generation paradigms, the first diffusion LM solution from a top lab with speed competitive to AR models
summary_en.technical_approach: Modified diffusion language modeling pipeline based on Gemma base model to achieve acceleration, full technical details not yet released
summary_en.experiments: Publicly claims 4x faster text generation than previous diffusion LM solutions, no detailed evaluation data available
summary_en.authors_note: Google DeepMind team, specific author information not disclosed

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM首次接近AR的实用速度，直接冲击现有文本生成范式，必须跟进后续公开的技术细节
recommendation.en: Diffusion LM first approaches practical speed comparable to AR, directly challenging current text generation paradigms, mandatory to follow upcoming details

paper.title: PathRelax: Parallel-Path Relaxed Speculative Jacobi Decoding for Accelerating Auto-Regressive Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: The growing need for high-resolution image generation in autoregressive text-to-image models has resulted in extended token sequences, significantly increasing computational costs and inference times. However, existing state-of-the-art methods for accelerating autoregressive text-to-image models rely on chain-structured draft token sequences, leading to inefficient draft token search and limited acceptance lengths. To address this, we propose parallel-path cross-relaxed speculative Jacobi decodi

summary.core_problem: 现有自回归文生图模型的推理加速方法受限于链式草稿结构，早期token被拒绝会导致后续所有草稿失效，接受长度短、加速比低；同时现有松弛验证仅考虑单token相似度，忽略草稿分支间的语义依赖。
summary.importance: 多路径树状结构+跨路径语义聚合的推测解码优化思路可推广到统一多模态基座离散token生成等长序列AR建模的推理加速场景，无需额外训练草稿模型的自推测方向也能降低大模型部署的额外成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PathSpec加速框架，包含两个核心设计：一是PathExplore，将线性链式草稿扩展为多序列树状结构，多个候选token序列并行生成并联合验证，单分支被拒绝不影响其他分支，缓解链式丢弃问题；二是PathRelax跨路径松弛验证，通过跨路径概率聚合建立语义相关分支的关联，利用语义邻居的接受结果提升整体接受率，扩展松弛空间。
summary.experiments: 在Lumina-mGPT上测试，无松弛的PathExplore平均接受长度是原有SJD方法的3.06倍；完整PathSpec框架在不同模型上至少提升20%的推理效率，同时不损失图像生成质量。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言部分对现有自推测解码局限性的分析、多路径树状草稿和跨路径松弛的核心设计，预计阅读时间12分钟，无需深入推导验证概率公式，重点理解对长序列AR解码的通用优化思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing acceleration methods for autoregressive text-to-image generation are limited by chain-structured draft sequences, where rejection of an early token invalidates all subsequent drafts, leading to short acceptance lengths and low speedup ratios. Existing relaxed verification also only considers single-token similarity, ignoring semantic dependencies across draft branches.
summary_en.importance: The multi-path tree structure and cross-path semantic aggregation design for speculative decoding can be generalized to inference acceleration of long-sequence AR modeling, including discrete token generation in unified multimodal foundation models. The draft-model-free self-speculative optimization direction also reduces additional deployment overhead for large models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The PathSpec acceleration framework includes two core components: PathExplore, which extends linear chain drafts to a multi-sequence tree structure, where multiple candidate token sequences are generated in parallel and jointly verified, so rejection of one branch does not affect others, mitigating cascading discard issues; PathRelax cross-path relaxed verification, which builds associations between semantically related branches via cross-path probability aggregation, uses acceptance results of semantic neighbors to improve overall acceptance rate and expand the relaxation space.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Lumina-mGPT, PathExplore without relaxation achieves 3.06x higher average acceptance length than the original SJD method. The full PathSpec framework improves inference efficiency by at least 20% across different models without degrading image generation quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of limitations of existing self-speculative decoding in the Introduction, and the core design of multi-path tree drafts and cross-path relaxation. Estimated reading time is 12 minutes; no need to dive into verification probability derivations, focus on the general optimization ideas for long-sequence AR decoding.

recommendation.zh: 将推测解码（Speculative Decoding）应用于自回归图像生成，通过并行多路径和语义放松验证提升接受率，对关注多模态 AR 模型推理优化的研究员有参考价值，重点看 PathRelax 的设计。
recommendation.en: Applies Speculative Decoding to autoregressive image generation, improving acceptance rates through parallel multi-paths and semantic relaxed verification. Valuable for researchers focusing on inference optimization of multimodal AR models; focus on the design of PathRelax.

paper.title: CLP: Collocation-Length Prediction for Zero-Loss Adaptive Multi-Token Inference
paper.abstract: Large language model inference is bottlenecked by autoregressive decoding, where each token requires a full forward pass. Multi-token prediction (MTP) offers a promising acceleration path, but existing approaches suffer from a fundamental architectural flaw: the MTP head for the first token competes with the backbone's own language model (LM) head, leading to severe quality degradation when predictions are accepted. We identify this head-backbone competition as the root cause of repetitive and i

summary.core_problem: 现有多token预测（MTP）推理加速方法存在根本架构缺陷：负责预测第一个后续token的MTP头与主干原生LM头预测同一位置，用精度更低的MTP头输出替换主干输出会导致生成质量严重下降；同时现有门控式接受决策机制存在信息不对称、过于保守、分布失配的固有局限，无法在保质量的前提下实现有效加速。
summary.importance: 定位了过往多token预测加速方法质量下降的根因，给出了零质量损失自适应多token推理的清晰架构原则，对推理部署及多token预测相关的后训练设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Backbone-as-Architect设计原则：主干LM头永远生成每个解码步的第一个token，MTP头仅负责预测t+2及之后的后续token，从架构上彻底消除头与主干的竞争，建立零质量损失基线。提出搭配长度预测器（CLP）：一个仅含4.6K-7.7K参数的单层线性层，基于主干隐藏状态预测可安全接受的后续MTP token数量，替代过往工作中过度设计的门控网络。另外对自适应MTP的质量-速度权衡做了系统的帕累托前沿分析，指出MTP头的预测精度是加速的核心约束。
summary.experiments: 核心实验结果包括：1）k=2的固定步长MTP方法输出重复率超过0.57，而标准贪心解码的重复率仅为0.019，验证了用MTP头输出替换主干输出带来的质量损失。2）现有的门控接受机制过于保守，平均接受长度仅0.4-0.6，几乎无法带来加速效果。3）Backbone-as-Architect设计消除了输出替换带来的质量下降，轻量CLP实现了自适应token接受，在无生成质量损失的前提下获得加速。
summary.reading_guide: 先阅读引言部分理解现有MTP方法缺陷的诊断过程，再了解Backbone-as-Architect设计原则与CLP的实现细节，重点查看质量-速度权衡的帕累托前沿分析、与过往MTP方法的对比实验。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-token prediction (MTP) inference acceleration methods suffer from a fundamental architectural flaw: the MTP head predicting the first next token competes with the backbone's native LM head for the same position, and replacing the more accurate backbone output with the lower-accuracy MTP head output causes severe generation quality degradation. Additionally, existing gate-based acceptance mechanisms have intrinsic limitations including information asymmetry, over-conservatism, and distribution mismatch, failing to deliver meaningful acceleration while preserving quality.
summary_en.importance: Identifies and resolves the root cause of quality degradation in prior MTP methods, provides a clean architectural principle for zero-quality-loss adaptive multi-token inference, and offers guidance for inference deployment and MTP-related post-training design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Backbone-as-Architect design principle is proposed: the backbone LM head always generates the first token at each decoding step, and MTP heads are only responsible for predicting tokens from position t+2 onward, eliminating head-backbone competition entirely and establishing a zero-quality-loss baseline. The Collocation-Length Predictor (CLP) is introduced: a single linear layer with only 4.6K-7.7K parameters that operates on the backbone's hidden state to predict the number of subsequent MTP tokens that can be safely accepted, replacing over-engineered gate networks in prior work. A systematic Pareto frontier analysis of the quality-speed tradeoff in adaptive MTP is also provided, identifying MTP head prediction accuracy as the binding constraint for acceleration.
summary_en.experiments: Key results: 1) Fixed-step MTP with k=2 produces outputs with a repetition ratio over 0.57, compared to 0.019 for standard greedy decoding, verifying the quality loss caused by replacing backbone outputs with MTP head predictions. 2) Existing gate-based acceptance mechanisms are over-conservative, achieving an average accepted length of only 0.4-0.6, delivering nearly no acceleration. 3) The Backbone-as-Architect design eliminates quality degradation from output substitution, and the lightweight CLP enables adaptive token acceptance, delivering acceleration without generation quality loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to understand the diagnosis of flaws in existing MTP methods, then review the Backbone-as-Architect principle and CLP implementation details, focus on the Pareto frontier analysis of quality-speed tradeoffs and comparison experiments with prior MTP approaches. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 明确了多token预测质量下降的核心根因，设计极简可落地，建议在内部推理加速方案中复用CLP的span级决策逻辑。
recommendation.en: Identifies the core root cause of quality degradation in multi-token prediction, with a minimal, production-ready design; reuse CLP's span-level decision logic for internal inference acceleration solutions.

paper.title: WhiFlash: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Token-Level Cross-Paradigm Routing
paper.abstract: The autoregressive nature of large language models (LLMs) remains a significant bottleneck for inference, particularly in complex agentic workloads. While speculative decoding (SD) accelerates inference, current approaches rely on static drafting paradigms, utilising either autoregressive drafting models for reasoning or diffusion-based parallel drafting models for structured outputs. We empirically find that drafting accuracy fluctuates dramatically within a single sequence, leaving significant

summary.core_problem: 解决推测解码（Speculative Decoding）中单一静态草稿模型（自回归或基于扩散的并行模型）在不同序列片段中准确率波动大、导致加速效果受限的问题。
summary.importance: 首次提出跨范式（自回归与扩散并行）的 token 级别推测解码路由机制，打破了现有推测解码依赖单一草稿模型范式的局限，为推理加速提供了新的优化维度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WhiFlash，一个在 token 级别统一自回归和基于扩散的并行草稿模型的控制器。采用细粒度路由机制，使用轻量级基于熵的策略或学习到的神经策略，在预期 token 增益和延迟之间进行可调平衡，以实现高频切换。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体加速比数字，但强调了其在处理复杂 agentic 工作负载时，通过动态切换草稿范式来应对草稿准确率剧烈波动的有效性。
summary.authors_note: Samsung AI Center Cambridge 团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing the limitation in Speculative Decoding where a single static drafting paradigm (autoregressive or diffusion-based parallel) suffers from fluctuating accuracy across different sequence segments, limiting acceleration.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first cross-paradigm (autoregressive and diffusion parallel) token-level routing mechanism for speculative decoding, breaking the limitation of relying on a single drafting paradigm and offering a new optimization dimension for inference acceleration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces WhiFlash, a token-level controller unifying autoregressive and diffusion-based parallel drafting models. It employs a fine-grained routing mechanism using either a lightweight entropy-based or a learned neural policy, parameterized to balance expected token gain and latency for high-frequency switching.
summary_en.experiments: Specific speedup numbers are not in the abstract, but it emphasizes effectiveness in handling complex agentic workloads by dynamically switching drafting paradigms to counter dramatic fluctuations in drafting accuracy.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by researchers at Samsung AI Center Cambridge.

recommendation.zh: 将 AR 和 Diffusion 草稿模型做 token-level 动态路由的想法很有新意，直击了不同生成阶段（推理 vs 结构化输出）对草稿模型能力需求不同的痛点，做推理加速的同学重点看其路由策略的 overhead 和实际端到端加速比。
recommendation.en: The idea of token-level dynamic routing between AR and Diffusion draft models is novel, directly addressing the varying capability needs of draft models across different generation phases (reasoning vs. structured output). Inference optimization researchers should focus on the routing overhead and actual end-to-end speedup.

paper.title: Mitigating the Contractivity Trap in Diffusion ODEs via Stein Stabilization
paper.abstract: A fundamental tension exists in the large-step inference of diffusion models via their deterministic probability flow ordinary differential equation (PF-ODE) trajectories, which we identify as the contractivity trap: efficient inference favors large step sizes, while aggressive steps and highly expressive denoisers can undermine contraction-based stability certificates for error suppression. To address this, we propose SteinDiff, a step-wise inference-time stabilization framework that employs St

summary.core_problem: 如何解决扩散模型在大步长推理时，由于高表达能力去噪器破坏收缩稳定性而导致的“收缩陷阱”问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需参考样本的推理时稳定框架，通过 Stein 修正来正则化大步长求解器更新，提高了扩散模型大步长推理的稳定性和效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SteinDiff 框架，引入几何感知的残差修正机制。推导了用于逐步求解器调整的闭式 Stein 修正系数，实现对局部数据几何的无参考自适应。建立分布偏移下的分数控制扰动界限。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中详细说明具体实验结果，主要强调了理论推导和方法提出。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the 'contractivity trap' in large-step inference of diffusion models, where highly expressive denoisers undermine contraction-based stability?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a reference-free inference-time stabilization framework that regularizes large-step solver updates via Stein corrections, improving the stability and efficiency of large-step inference in diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the SteinDiff framework with a geometry-aware residual correction mechanism. Derives a closed-form Stein correction coefficient for step-wise solver adjustment, enabling reference-free adaptation to local data geometry. Establishes a score-controlled perturbation bound under distributional shifts.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental results are not detailed in the abstract; the focus is on theoretical derivation and method proposal.

recommendation.zh: 从理论角度分析并缓解了扩散模型大步长推理的稳定性问题，对关注 Diffusion 采样效率和理论机制的研究员有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Analyzes and mitigates the stability issues of large-step inference in diffusion models from a theoretical perspective, valuable for researchers focusing on Diffusion sampling efficiency and theoretical mechanisms.

paper.title: Parallel Jacobi Decoding for Fast Autoregressive Image Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models have demonstrated remarkable performance in generating high-fidelity images. However, their inherently sequential next-token prediction leads to significantly slower inference. Recent studies have introduced Jacobi-style decoding to accelerate autoregressive image generation. Extending the draft sequence initially improves efficiency, yet the acceleration quickly saturates as error propagation in the one-dimensional sequence hinders convergence. Observing that images e

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是自回归图像生成的解码速度问题：逐 token 生成太慢，而直接把文本 LLM 的 Jacobi decoding 搬到图像上会受一维序列误差传播限制。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发在于视觉 token 序列不应完全按文本序列处理。AR 图像模型虽然使用 raster-scan token 序列训练，但图像 token 的依赖有明显局部空间结构。PJD 利用这一点做 training-free decoding 加速，说明统一 AR 建模在推理阶段仍需要尊重模态结构。它对预训练目标本身改动不大，但对 AR 视觉 token 模型、统一多模态 LM 的 serving 和 decoding 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 传统 Jacobi decoding 会在确认前缀之后初始化一个未来窗口，并用固定点迭代并行更新窗口内 token。窗口变长后，后面的 token 会看到更多尚未稳定的候选 token，误差沿一维序列累积，收敛速度很快饱和。PJD 的改动是把 draft expansion 从一维窗口转为二维空间并行。图像 token 虽然被 raster-scan 展平，但相邻空间位置的相关性更强；因此当当前行提供足够上下文后，方法会初始化下一行的 draft token，并在多个空间区域内并行细化。它通过调整 attention mask 来限制不可靠候选 token 的影响，同时保留自回归依赖关系。整个方法不需要额外训练 draft model，也不需要改动原模型参数，和 speculative decoding 相比部署成本更低。
summary.experiments: 实验在两个 AR 图像生成模型上验证：Lumina-mGPT 和 LlamaGen。论文报告 PJD 在 Lumina-mGPT 上最高达到 6.4 倍加速，在 LlamaGen 上最高达到 4.8 倍加速，同时保持接近原始自回归解码的生成质量。速度收益随图像分辨率增大而上升，这符合二维空间并行的设计预期：分辨率越高，可并行细化的局部区域越多。实验还比较了普通 Jacobi decoding 等加速方法，结论是单纯增加一维 draft 长度会遇到收敛瓶颈，而利用行间和局部空间结构更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15-20 分钟。先看引言中的 Figure 2，理解作者关于图像 token 局部 attention 的观察；再看方法部分中 Jacobi decoding 的固定点形式，以及 PJD 如何把窗口扩展到二维网格。实验部分重点看 speed-quality tradeoff、不同分辨率下的加速曲线、以及和普通 Jacobi decoding 的收敛步数对比。对 LLM 预训练研究员来说，不必细读图像质量指标细节，更值得关注的是它如何利用模态结构改写 decoding schedule。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the inference bottleneck of autoregressive image generation: token-by-token decoding is slow, and standard one-dimensional Jacobi decoding suffers from error propagation when the draft window becomes long.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson is that visual token sequences should not be decoded exactly like text, even when the model is trained autoregressively over a flattened raster order. Image tokens have strong local spatial dependencies. PJD exploits this structure at inference time without retraining the model. This is more relevant to decoding and serving than to pretraining itself, but it matters for AR visual token models and unified multimodal LMs that rely on discrete image tokens.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conventional Jacobi decoding initializes a future token window after a confirmed prefix and iteratively refines all draft tokens in parallel until part of the window stabilizes. As the one-dimensional window grows, later positions attend to more uncertain draft tokens, which slows convergence. Parallel Jacobi Decoding changes the expansion geometry. Instead of extending only along the flattened sequence, it initializes draft tokens in the next image row once enough spatial context is available, then refines multiple spatial regions in parallel. The method modifies the attention mask to reduce the influence of unstable candidates while preserving the autoregressive dependency pattern. It is training-free and does not require a separate draft model, which distinguishes it from speculative decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Lumina-mGPT and LlamaGen. The reported speedups reach 6.4x on Lumina-mGPT and 4.8x on LlamaGen while maintaining comparable image quality to standard autoregressive decoding. The speedup increases at higher resolutions, which supports the central claim that two-dimensional spatial parallelism becomes more useful as the token grid grows. The comparisons also show why simply enlarging a one-dimensional Jacobi draft window is insufficient: convergence saturates due to accumulated uncertainty in the draft sequence.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15-20 minute skim is enough. Start with the attention/locality observation in Figure 2, then read the method section contrasting standard Jacobi fixed-point iteration with the proposed two-dimensional schedule. In the experiments, focus on the speed-quality curves, resolution scaling behavior, and convergence comparisons against vanilla Jacobi decoding. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main takeaway is the decoding schedule design, not the image benchmark details.

recommendation.zh: 将推测解码（Jacobi decoding）扩展到二维空间以加速自回归图像生成，对关注视觉Tokenizer和统一建模的效率优化有启发。
recommendation.en: Extends Jacobi decoding to 2D space for accelerating AR image generation, offering insights for efficiency optimization in visual tokenizers and unified modeling.

paper.title: Fast-dLLM++: Fréchet Profile Decoding for Faster Diffusion LLM Inference

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion LLM 推理里的一个很具体但关键的问题：在并行解码时，哪些 masked 位置可以在同一步里一起“提交”而不明显伤害质量。Fast-dLLM 已经给出过基于置信度的并行提交规则，但它把候选集合压缩成“最弱那个 token 的置信度”来做决策，相当于用最坏情况代表整个集合。论文指出这在真实解码里过于保守，因为不同位置的置信度往往高度异质：少数位置几乎确定，少数位置只是中等确定。如果仍按 weakest-token 规则裁剪，就会白白损失可并行性，导致 diffusion LM 理论上的并行优势在实际推理里兑现不足。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是训练范式创新，而是 diffusion LM 走向可用推理路径上的一块基础拼图。价值主要有三层。第一，它把“并行提交”从经验启发式推进到更严格的分布无关证书，说明在只知道边缘置信度、不了解位置间依赖结构时，还能做到多保守、多激进。第二，它直接服务于 diffusion/MDLM 这条非 AR 语言建模路线的现实瓶颈：如果推理速度始终被保守提交规则卡住，再好的训练目标也很难形成系统优势。第三，它给出一个很清楚的结论：异质置信度不是噪声，而是可利用的结构信号。这个判断对后续做 profile-aware decoding、学习式提交策略、甚至训练时显式塑造置信度分布，都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是 training-free 的，对已有 diffusion LLM 直接替换提交规则。核心做法叫 Fréchet profile decoding。设当前一步有若干 masked 位置，每个位置都有模型给出的 greedy token 及其边缘置信度。Fast-dLLM 的 factor rule 只看 top-n 候选里最小的那个置信度 c(n)，接受条件形如 (n+1)(1-c(n)) < f，本质是把所有已选 token 当成同一置信度处理。Fast-dLLM++ 则保留完整排序后的置信度 profile (c(1), c(2), ..., c(n))，对每个前缀大小 n 计算两个量：一是所有 n 个 greedy token 同时正确的联合概率下界 Ln；二是任意竞争 tuple 的概率上界 Un。若 Ln - Un > δ，就认为这个前缀足够安全，可以整体提交，并选择满足条件的最大前缀。

这里的关键不是换了一个经验分数，而是用了 Fréchet 型界来构造“只依赖边缘概率、对依赖关系最坏情况仍成立”的保守证书。论文证明了：在没有额外位置依赖信息时，这类 Fréchet 下界已经是 distribution-free 场景下最强的保守证书之一；也就是说，只靠边缘置信度，理论上很难再做得更强。另一个重要点是它和旧规则的关系。作者证明在 equal-confidence 特例下，新规则会退化回 Fast-dLLM 的 factor decoding，因此它不是另起炉灶，而是对 homogeneous-confidence 假设的严格推广。

论文还给出 heterogeneity bonus 分解，解释为什么 profile-aware 规则能多提交 token：当 profile 前部有一批极高置信度位置时，联合正确事件的下界不会像 weakest-token 近似那样被末尾中等置信度位置完全拖垮，因此可接受前缀会更长。工程上它兼容 KV cache 和不同 cache regime，不需要额外 verifier 或 drafter，这一点和 AR 里的 speculative decoding 路线不同。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖文本推理、代码和多模态推理，模型包括 LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-v0-Base-7B，以及多模态版本 LLaDA-V；任务包括 GSM8K、MATH、HumanEval、MBPP。论文主结果不是单点精度，而是 accuracy-throughput frontier：在相同质量下获得更高吞吐，或在相同吞吐下保持更好准确率。按照文中描述，Fast-dLLM++ 在多种 generation length 和 cache 设置下都优于原始 Fast-dLLM 的 threshold/factor 规则，收益在置信度分布更异质、生成更长、并行空间更大的场景更明显。

消融的重点有三类。第一，equal-confidence 与 heterogeneous-confidence 对比，验证理论上新规则在同质情形退化为旧规则，而在异质情形出现额外并行收益。第二，margin 参数 δ、不同 cache regime、不同 commit size 的敏感性分析，用来展示速度和质量之间的可调边界。第三，多任务与多模型泛化，说明收益不是某个特定 diffusion LM 或某个 benchmark 的偶然现象。给出的全文片段里没有完整表格数字，因此不适合编造具体提升百分比；但从实验组织看，作者是在用“前沿曲线整体右移”而不是单个点胜负来论证方法有效，这对解码论文是更合理的证据形式。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三处。第一，看 Introduction 和方法总览图，明确它到底替换了 Fast-dLLM 的哪一部分，以及为什么 weakest-token 假设会保守。第二，看理论部分里关于 Theorem 4.1 和 strongest distribution-free certificate 的论证，这决定了方法不是拍脑袋调规则，而是在“只知道边缘置信度”这个信息约束下尽量做满。第三，看 heterogeneity-bonus decomposition 和主实验的 frontier 图，理解收益来自哪里，而不是只记住“更快”。

如果时间有限，建议阅读顺序是：Introduction → 提交规则定义 → equal-confidence 退化关系 → 主实验图。预计 25–35 分钟可以把主要思想读清。若想深挖，重点看 Fréchet 下界如何构造、Un 如何定义，以及这些界在真实模型校准误差存在时是否仍稳健。这也是后续研究最值得追问的地方：当前证书只利用边缘置信度，若能引入轻量依赖估计，是否还能继续放宽提交条件。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a central inference bottleneck in diffusion LLMs: deciding which masked positions can be committed in parallel at each denoising step without hurting generation quality too much. Fast-dLLM already introduced confidence-guided commit rules, but its theory collapses a candidate set to the weakest selected token. That is a worst-case homogeneous-confidence approximation. The authors argue this is unnecessarily conservative because real confidence profiles are highly heterogeneous: a few positions are near-certain while others are only moderately confident. If the whole set is judged by the weakest token, useful parallelism is left unused.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it matters for the viability of diffusion-style language modeling as a competing paradigm to autoregressive decoding. Its contribution is mainly on the inference side, yet the implication is broader: if diffusion LMs cannot cash out their parallel-generation advantage at decode time, architectural or objective-level gains will not translate into system-level wins. The paper also makes a more general point that confidence heterogeneity is exploitable structure rather than nuisance. That idea could later feed back into training, calibration, or learned commit policies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Fast-dLLM++ is a training-free replacement for the commit rule used during diffusion decoding. Instead of using only the weakest confidence among the top-n candidate positions, it keeps the full sorted confidence profile (c(1), c(2), ..., c(n)). For each candidate prefix of size n, it computes a Fréchet lower bound L_n on the probability that all n marginal greedy tokens are jointly correct, and an upper bound U_n on the probability of any competing tuple. The decoder commits the largest prefix satisfying L_n - U_n > delta, where delta is a safety margin.

The key technical move is that the certificate is built from marginal confidences only, with no explicit dependence model across positions. The paper proves that this yields a heterogeneous-confidence sufficient condition under which greedy parallel decoding matches the true joint greedy decision. It further argues that, without additional dependence information, the Fréchet-based certificate is the strongest conservative distribution-free guarantee available from marginals alone. This is the main theoretical claim.

Another useful result is the reduction to the previous rule: in the equal-confidence case, the new criterion collapses exactly to Fast-dLLM factor decoding. So the method is not a disconnected heuristic; it is a strict generalization of the homogeneous-confidence analysis. The heterogeneity-bonus decomposition then explains when gains appear: if the confidence profile has a strong head and a weaker tail, the full-profile certificate can still justify committing a larger set, whereas the weakest-token rule gets dominated by the tail. Operationally, the method remains compatible with KV caching and does not require a separate drafter or verifier, unlike speculative decoding for AR models.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans reasoning, math, code, and multimodal reasoning. Models include LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-v0-Base-7B, and LLaDA-V. Benchmarks include GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MBPP. The main empirical claim is not a single-point accuracy gain but a better accuracy-throughput frontier: at matched quality, Fast-dLLM++ achieves higher throughput; at matched throughput, it preserves better accuracy than prior threshold/factor rules.

The ablations are structured around the theory. First, the paper contrasts homogeneous and heterogeneous confidence settings, showing that the new rule reduces to the old one in the equal-confidence regime and gains only when profile heterogeneity exists. Second, it studies the effect of the margin parameter, cache regimes, and generation length, which clarifies the speed-quality trade-off. Third, it tests multiple models and tasks to argue the effect is not benchmark-specific. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the final numeric tables, so it is better not to invent exact deltas. Still, the experimental design is appropriate for a decoding paper because it focuses on frontier shifts rather than isolated wins.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the main method figure to understand exactly what part of Fast-dLLM is being replaced and why the weakest-token abstraction is too conservative. Second, read the theorem establishing the sufficient condition and the claim about the strongest distribution-free certificate. That is the difference between a principled decoding rule and another heuristic. Third, inspect the heterogeneity-bonus analysis and the main frontier plots to see where the practical gains come from.

A good reading order is: Introduction -> commit rule definition -> reduction to the equal-confidence case -> main experimental figures. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough for the main idea. If reading more deeply, pay attention to how L_n and U_n are constructed and ask how robust the certificate is under calibration error in model confidences. That is likely the most important follow-up question.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在跟踪 AR 之外的 LM 范式，这篇该看；先盯速度-质量折中表，若只省步数不省 wall-clock，就别高估它。
recommendation.en: If you track non-AR LM paradigms, this is worth a look; focus on the speed-quality tradeoff table first—if it cuts steps but not wall-clock, do not overrate it.

paper.title: TreeFlash: Parallel AR-Approximation for Faster Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: One-shot block drafters for speculative decoding generate the full draft in a single forward pass, achieving strong throughput by eliminating sequential token generation. However, they predict each draft token conditioned only on the prefix context, with no dependence on previously drafted tokens. This non-autoregressive conditioning causes the drafter's distribution to diverge from the verifier's true autoregressive distribution as draft depth grows. This problem becomes more severe in tree-bas

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 one-shot speculative decoding drafter 的条件化不足问题。DFlash 这类方法一次前向生成整个 draft block，每个位置只条件化在原始 prefix 上，而不看 block 内已经草拟出的前一个 token。draft 深度越大，drafter 分布和 verifier 的自回归分布偏差越大；在 tree drafting 中，不同分支还会被迫共享后续 token 的边缘分布，树的质量进一步下降。
summary.importance: 这是一篇推理加速论文，对预训练研究的间接价值在于：它把“非自回归并行草稿”和“自回归条件依赖”之间的冲突拆得比较清楚。训练大模型时通常只关心主模型 loss，但服务阶段的吞吐越来越依赖 drafter/verifier 协同。TreeFlash 说明，小型辅助模块的训练目标、条件信息和树构造策略会显著影响 verifier 的接受率。它不改变基座模型训练，但对设计可服务的预训练模型、输出 embedding 复用、speculative-friendly 表征有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: TreeFlash 在 DFlash 式 one-shot drafter 上加入一个轻量 AR-approximation 模块。核心做法是：对 draft 位置 t+i 的 hidden state h̃_{t+i}，额外输入前一个 token 的 embedding e_{t+i-1}，通过一个 SwiGLU MLP 得到修正后的 hidden state h'_{t+i}，再复用 verifier 的 output embedding 得到 q'(x_{t+i}|x_{≤t}, x_{t+i-1})。这样只近似依赖前一个 token，而不是恢复完整自回归生成，所以保留并行性。为了避免对每个深度顺序调用 AR approximator，论文采用两阶段树构造。第一阶段用原始 DFlash 分布构造 top-M-ary tree；第二阶段只在这个 M-ary tree 的节点上并行应用 AR-approximator，再用 OPT-Tree 算法选择最终预算为 B 的 draft tree。因为每个深度只有 M 个 unique preceding tokens，计算量是 M·γ 次并行评估，不随最终 draft budget B 顺序增长。训练上，backbone 从 DFlash checkpoint 初始化，AR-approximator 零初始化，以保证初始行为接近原模型；训练样本中抽多个 random anchor positions，用 ground-truth preceding token 作为条件输入；损失从 DFlash 的 target-token cross entropy 改为对 verifier distribution 的 forward KL，以更直接地拟合 verifier 的条件分布。
summary.experiments: 正文片段给出的关键实验信息包括：作者用总变差距离展示，边缘分布 q(x_{t+i}|x_{≤t}) 与 verifier 自回归分布 p(x_{t+i}|x_{<t+i}) 的偏差会随 draft depth 增大；TreeFlash 相比完全边缘化的 one-shot 分布有更好的 tree quality 和 speculative decoding 性能；消融覆盖 AR-approximator 架构、训练目标以及 top-M branching factor。验证过程采用 deterministic token selection 和 equality check，因此保持 lossless generation。提供的内容没有包含具体模型规模、token/s、acceptance length、speedup 或 benchmark 数字，实际采用时需要回到实验表和吞吐测量细节核对。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 DFlash/DDTree 局限的分析，尤其是 draft depth 下分布偏移的图。然后看 Method 的两部分：SwiGLU AR-approximation 公式，以及 top-M tree 到 OPT-Tree 的两阶段构造。训练细节值得扫一遍，重点是 forward KL to verifier distribution 和 zero initialization。实验部分主要看 acceptance、throughput、M 与 B 的消融，不必深读理论背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a conditioning gap in one-shot speculative drafters. Methods such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one forward pass, but each draft position is conditioned only on the prefix, not on earlier drafted tokens. As draft depth increases, this marginal distribution drifts away from the verifier’s autoregressive distribution. The issue is amplified in tree drafting, where different branches are forced to share the same marginal distribution for later tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but concrete: it clarifies the trade-off between parallel draft generation and autoregressive conditional structure. Modern serving performance depends heavily on the interaction between a verifier and auxiliary drafters, and TreeFlash shows that the drafter’s conditioning, training target, and tree construction can materially affect acceptance. It does not change the base model pretraining objective, but it is useful when thinking about speculative-friendly representations and output-head reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: TreeFlash adds a lightweight AR-approximation layer to a DFlash-style one-shot drafter. For draft position t+i, the module takes the drafter hidden state and the embedding of the previous token, passes them through a SwiGLU MLP, and produces a modified hidden state. The verifier’s output embedding is then reused to produce q'(x_{t+i}|x_{≤t}, x_{t+i-1}). This gives a local autoregressive dependency without turning the drafter into a sequential model. To avoid sequentially applying the approximator across draft depth, the method uses a two-stage tree construction. First, it builds a top-M-ary tree using the original DFlash marginals. Second, it applies the AR-approximator in parallel over the nodes of this tree and then uses OPT-Tree selection to form the final draft tree under budget B. Since only M unique previous tokens appear at each depth, the modified distributions require M·γ parallel evaluations and preserve O(1) drafting depth. Training initializes from a pretrained DFlash checkpoint, zero-initializes the AR-approximation layer, samples multiple random anchor positions, conditions on ground-truth previous tokens, and replaces target-token cross-entropy with forward KL to the verifier distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports that the total variation distance between prefix-only marginals and the verifier’s autoregressive distribution grows with draft depth, motivating the approximation. TreeFlash improves over fully marginal one-shot distributions, with ablations on the AR-approximation architecture, the training objective, and the top-M branching factor. The verification procedure uses deterministic token selection and equality checks, preserving lossless generation. Exact numbers for model size, accepted tokens per step, tokens/sec, speedup, and benchmark settings are not present in the provided excerpt and should be checked in the full tables before drawing quantitative conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 minute skim should be sufficient. Read the introduction for the failure mode of DFlash and DDTree-style one-shot tree drafting. Then focus on the method section: the SwiGLU AR-approximation equation and the two-stage top-M plus OPT-Tree construction. The training details are useful, especially forward KL to the verifier and zero initialization. In the experiments, prioritize acceptance, throughput, and the ablations over M and B.

recommendation.zh: 推测解码的增量改进，核心近似自回归的设计有参考价值，只看方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to speculative decoding, the core autoregressive approximation design is worth referring to, only read the method section

paper.title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding

summary.core_problem: 在 tree-based speculative decoding 里，如何在“覆盖更多候选（更高接受长度）”与“验证更贵（更慢）”之间做在线权衡：每一轮到底该用多大的 draft tree（node budget），以及节点该放在哪里，才能最大化真实吞吐（tokens/sec），而不是一个单调随预算增大的代理指标。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏推理侧，但对“训练—推理闭环”有两点直接启发：第一，把优化目标从 acceptance length 拉回到端到端吞吐，属于把系统代价显式写进目标函数的典型做法；第二，它给出了一个可操作的、无需额外训练的在线预算自适应机制，能减少 speculative decoding 在不同 prompt/不同阶段的手工调参。对预训练研究的间接价值在于：当推理侧能更稳定地榨干吞吐，训练侧做 recipe/架构改动时更容易把收益归因到模型本身，而不是 serving 配置。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把“树怎么长 + 树多大”统一成一个 throughput 最大化问题。
1) 现有 DDTree 类方法：用 block diffusion drafter 一次前向给出每个位置的 marginal q_i(v)，在 drafter 的因子化联合分布 Q 下计算每个节点（前缀）出现概率，从而得到期望接受长度的可加和代理目标 Φ(T)，然后在固定预算 n=|T| 下选节点。问题在于：Φ(T) 对预算是非减的，导致预算选择没有原则，离线选一个 n 只能靠网格搜索或经验。
2) CaDDTree：显式建模每轮耗时，把目标改为“单位时间期望提交 token 数”。一轮提交 1+α（含 bonus token），于是吞吐可写成 E[1+α] / (draft_cost(n)+verify_cost(n))（文中把 draft 与 verify 的代价函数化；对 block diffusion drafter，draft_cost 近似常数或弱依赖 n，而 verify_cost 随树节点数增长）。
3) 关键理论点：在一个温和的凸性条件下（验证代价随 n 的增长呈凸/边际成本递增），吞吐关于 n 呈单峰（unimodal）。这使得“预算搜索”从高维组合问题降为一维搜索：先按某个节点收益排序/贪心扩展树结构，同时用单峰性质做高效停止/回退，得到每轮的最优 n，并且能随上下文变化在线调整。
4) 实现层面：框架落在 block diffusion drafting（如 DFlash 这类一次出 L 个位置 logits 的 drafter）+ tree attention 验证上；不需要训练新模型，只改树构造与预算选择策略。
summary.experiments:
全文信息在给定内容里只出现了实验设置与结论性描述，缺少表格数字与具体超参：
- 模型：Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B（target），使用 block diffusion drafter（文中以 DFlash/同类为背景）。
- 任务：8 个 benchmark，覆盖 reasoning、coding、instruction-following。
- 结论：CaDDTree 在几乎所有任务上达到或超过“带 oracle 预算选择”的 DDTree；并且不需要离线预算搜索，能 per-round 自适应预算。
- 你在精读时需要重点核对：吞吐提升的绝对比例（tokens/sec 或 speedup）、不同任务/不同上下文长度下最优预算分布、以及 verify_cost 的拟合/测量方式是否稳定（是否受 batch size、tree attention 实现、KV cache 复用影响）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction：明确它反对“最大化接受长度”而主张“最大化吞吐”的动机，以及为什么预算选择是痛点。
- 重点看方法部分对 cost model 的定义：draft_cost/verify_cost 如何测量或近似，哪些项随 n 变化；这决定了单峰假设是否可信。
- 找到并细读“unimodality 条件与证明/推导”：这是把在线预算选择做成可实现算法的关键。
- 最后看实验里与 DDTree（含 oracle budget）对比的主表，以及预算自适应的可视化（如果有）：确认收益来自更好的 n 选择，而不是仅仅换了树形贪心。
- 如果你关心预训练侧启发：把它当作一个范式例子——把系统代价写进目标函数，并用可验证的结构性质（单峰/凸性）把搜索问题降维。

summary_en.core_problem: How to construct and size draft trees in tree-based speculative decoding so that the objective matches real throughput (expected committed tokens per unit time), including an online choice of the node budget per decoding round, instead of optimizing a surrogate (expected acceptance length) that is monotonic in budget and therefore cannot justify budget selection.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference paper, but it matters to foundation-model practitioners in two practical ways. (1) It is a clean example of making system cost part of the optimization target: acceptance-only objectives systematically push toward larger trees, while throughput exposes the true trade-off. (2) It provides an online, per-round budget adaptation mechanism without extra training, reducing the amount of offline tuning typically needed for speculative decoding. Indirectly, more stable inference speedups help pretraining researchers attribute gains to model/recipe changes rather than serving heuristics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CaDDTree reframes draft-tree construction as throughput maximization.
- Setup: a block-diffusion drafter produces per-position marginals q_i in one forward pass (factorized joint Q), enabling tractable computation of node/prefix probabilities used by DDTree-style methods.
- Limitation of prior work: maximizing expected accepted length under Q (a surrogate for the target model) is non-decreasing in the node budget n=|T|, so it cannot determine the right budget; existing adaptive-shape methods still fix n offline.
- Key change: define a per-round throughput objective, roughly E[1+α(T)] / (draft_cost(n)+verify_cost(n)), where α is the number of accepted tokens and costs are explicit functions of tree size.
- Main theoretical lever: under a mild convexity assumption on verification cost (increasing marginal cost with n), throughput as a function of n becomes unimodal. This reduces budget selection to an efficient 1D search/greedy procedure that jointly grows the tree and decides when to stop, enabling per-round budget adaptation.
- Instantiation: the framework is implemented on top of block diffusion drafting plus tree-attention verification; no additional model training is required.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, only high-level experimental descriptors are available (tables/numbers are not included):
- Targets: Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B.
- Evaluation: 8 benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction following.
- Reported outcome: CaDDTree matches or exceeds DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks, while avoiding offline budget tuning.
For a careful read, the critical missing details to verify in the paper are: absolute throughput gains (tokens/s or speedup), sensitivity to context length and batch size, how verify_cost is measured/fitted for tree attention, and whether improvements come mainly from better budget choice or from different node selection.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction to internalize the misalignment argument (acceptance length vs throughput) and why budget selection is the core gap.
- Focus on the cost model section: what exactly scales with n in verification, and what is assumed constant for block diffusion drafting.
- Read the unimodality condition and its derivation/proof; this is the technical hinge that makes online budget adaptation feasible.
- Check the main comparison against DDTree (including the oracle-budget variant) and any plots showing per-round chosen budgets.
- If you care about pretraining-adjacent lessons: treat it as a template for “objective alignment with real cost” plus “structure (convexity/unimodality) to make search tractable.”

recommendation.zh: 将扩散机制引入推测解码的草稿树构建，并显式建模 cost，对关注推理加速和 Speculative Decoding 优化的工程师有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Introduces diffusion mechanisms into draft tree construction for speculative decoding and explicitly models cost; valuable for engineers focused on inference acceleration and Speculative Decoding optimization.

paper.title: DFlare: Scaling Up Draft Capacity for Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Block diffusion speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by predicting all tokens within a block simultaneously for the target model to verify in parallel. Predicting an entire block at once requires a sufficiently capable draft model and effective utilization of the target model's internal knowledge. However, the state-of-the-art method DFlash constrains all draft layers to share a single fused representation derived from only a few target layers, limiting per-layer expressiveness and hin

summary.core_problem: Block diffusion speculative decoding 依赖“draft 一次性预测整块 token、target 并行验证”的范式，速度取决于 acceptance length（每次验证能接受多少 draft token）。现有 DFlash 在两点上卡住：一是 draft 加深后收益递减；二是 target knowledge injection 采用“少数 target 层 → 单一融合表示 → 所有 draft 层共享”的窄瓶颈，导致各层输入同质、难以分工，进一步让加深无效。论文要解决的是：如何在几乎不增加开销的前提下扩大 conditioning 带宽，让更深的 diffusion draft 真正变强，从而提升 acceptance length 与端到端加速比。
summary.importance:
这是推理效率方向的工作，但对基座研究也有两点信息增益：
- 证明了在 block diffusion drafting 里，“如何注入 target 表征”会直接决定 draft 深度 scaling 是否有效，属于结构性瓶颈而非纯训练技巧。
- 给出一个很轻量的 layer-wise fusion 设计：用极少参数把 conditioning 从单点广播变成分层差异化输入，属于可迁移的架构小模块（也可能启发训练期的 teacher-student/representation distillation 设计）。
整体贡献量级偏工程与系统优化：在多个模型上带来稳定的额外 speedup（相对 DFlash 约 5–11%）。
summary.technical_approach:
DFlare 在 DFlash 的框架上做三件事：
1) Layer-wise fusion（核心）：不再把少数 target 层 hidden states 融成一个向量给所有 draft 层共享，而是让每个 draft layer l 都学习一组标量权重，对一组更“宽”的 target layers hidden states 做加权和，得到该层专属的 conditioning。计算上只是标量加权求和，额外开销很小，但打破了“所有层看同一个信号”的表达力上限。
2) Scale draft depth：在 layer-wise fusion 之后，加深 draft 不再快速饱和，因为每层有不同的 target 视角可用，能形成分工与层级表征。
3) Scale training data：把训练样本从 800K 扩到 2.4M，以匹配更深、更有表达力的 draft，避免容量上去但监督不够导致的欠拟合/不稳定。

与 DFlash 的关键区别就是 conditioning bottleneck：DFlash 的 fused representation 是“窄且共享”，DFlare 把它“展开”为 per-layer 的可学习融合，并且融合的 target 层数更多（文中举例 9 vs 5）。
summary.experiments:
论文在 6 个基准（覆盖数学推理、代码生成、通用对话）上报告 wall-clock speedup：
- Qwen3-4B：平均 5.52×
- Qwen3-8B：平均 5.46×
- GPT-OSS-20B：平均 3.91×
相对 DFlash 的提升约为：11%（Qwen3-4B）、8%（Qwen3-8B）、5%（GPT-OSS-20B）。

关键实验主线是：layer-wise fusion 让 acceptance length 随 draft 深度更稳定地增长（而不是像 DFlash 那样很快递减），以及扩大训练数据后性能继续提升。阅读时建议确认：acceptance length 的具体提升曲线、不同 block size/扩散步数下的表现、以及融合 target 层数从少到多的边际收益。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 把 DFlash 的“共享融合表示”为什么限制深度 scaling 讲清楚。
- 看 Preliminaries 复习 DFlash 的 drafting+verification 流程与 conditioning 注入点，避免只看改动不理解系统。
- 精看 layer-wise fusion 的公式与实现：每层的标量权重如何参数化、融合哪些 target layers、是否对不同层做归一化/约束。
- 结果部分优先看 Figure 1 左右两张：一张是相对 DFlash 的 speedup 对比，一张是数据规模从 800K→2.4M 的 scaling 曲线；再看 acceptance length vs depth 的曲线（如果有）。
- 如果做系统落地，额外关注：训练成本（2.4M 样本训练的代价）、对 target 模型前向中间层读取的工程开销、以及在不同硬件/并行策略下 speedup 是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: Block-diffusion speculative decoding drafts an entire token block in one shot and lets the target model verify in parallel; end-to-end speed hinges on acceptance length. DFlash hits a coupled bottleneck: deeper drafts stop helping, largely because all draft layers share the same narrow fused conditioning signal from only a few target layers. The paper addresses how to widen and differentiate target-conditioning so draft depth can scale and acceptance length improves without meaningful overhead.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference-efficiency contribution, but it carries a clear architectural lesson: in block-diffusion drafting, representation injection design can be the limiting factor for depth scaling, not just training or model size. The proposed layer-wise fusion is a small, transferable module that may also inform teacher-student representation distillation designs. Empirically, it yields consistent additional wall-clock gains over DFlash (roughly 5–11% relative improvement depending on the target).
summary_en.technical_approach:
DFlare extends DFlash with three coordinated changes:
1) Layer-wise fusion (main idea): instead of a single fused target representation broadcast to every draft layer, each draft layer learns its own scalar-weighted combination over a broader set of target hidden states. This creates per-layer distinct conditioning, enabling specialization. The fusion is computationally cheap (a few scalar weights and weighted sums).
2) Draft depth scaling: with differentiated conditioning, adding draft layers produces consistent acceptance-length gains rather than saturating quickly.
3) Training data scaling: the training set is increased from 800K to 2.4M samples to match the expanded draft capacity.

Key delta vs DFlash: removing the shared conditioning bottleneck and increasing the number of target layers used for conditioning (example given: 9 vs 5).
summary_en.experiments:
Reported average wall-clock speedups across six benchmarks (math, code, chat):
- 5.52× on Qwen3-4B
- 5.46× on Qwen3-8B
- 3.91× on GPT-OSS-20B
Relative to DFlash, improvements are about 11%, 8%, and 5% respectively.

The experimental narrative emphasizes (a) acceptance length improving more reliably with draft depth under layer-wise fusion, and (b) continued gains when scaling training data to 2.4M. When reading, check the acceptance-length vs depth curves, the effect of using more/fewer target layers in fusion, and sensitivity to block size / diffusion steps.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the diagnosis: why shared fused conditioning makes deeper drafts redundant.
- Use Preliminaries to align on DFlash’s drafting/verification loop and where conditioning enters.
- Focus on the layer-wise fusion formulation and implementation details (which target layers, how weights are parameterized/normalized).
- In Results, prioritize Figure 1 (speedup comparison and data-scaling curve), then any plots tying acceptance length to draft depth and fusion width.
- For deployment-minded readers: note the cost of training on 2.4M samples, engineering overhead of extracting multiple target-layer states, and whether speedups hold across hardware/parallelism settings.

recommendation.zh: 块扩散推测解码的合理增量改进，层级融合设计简洁有效，只需阅读方法部分的核心设计即可
recommendation.en: This is a reasonable incremental improvement to block diffusion speculative decoding; only the layer-wise fusion design in the method section is worth reading

paper.title: SimSD: Simple Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs, offering faster inference through parallel or blockwise decoding. However, their masked language modeling formulation remains incompatible with standard token-level speculative decoding, one of the most effective acceleration techniques for AR models. In AR decoding, the causal mask preserves temporally valid token-level contexts, enabling a target model to verify multiple drafte

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（dLLM）基于掩码语言建模和双向注意力的设计，无法直接适配AR模型常用的token级推测解码加速技术。dLLM的有效上下文会随去噪步骤动态变化，无法维持时序有效的token级上下文，限制了推理速度的进一步提升。
summary.importance: 给dLLM推理加速提供了无训练成本的通用方案，让扩散语言模型可以复用AR领域成熟的推测解码技术，同时兼容已有的块解码、KV缓存等加速方法，对dLLM落地部署有实用价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SimSD方法，核心是设计即插即用的注意力掩码策略：一是构造特殊输入布局，每个待预测位置对应两个token槽，一个存储小参考模型生成的草稿token作为参考上下文，另一个作为预测槽计算logits；二是设计时序因果注意力掩码，让预测槽可以访问对应位置的参考上下文和当前步其他可见token，从而在单次前向传播中完成多个草稿token的验证。整个过程不需要额外训练，可直接接入现有dLLM解码流水线。
summary.experiments: 在SDAR系列dLLM上跨GSM8K、MBPP、TriviaQA、MMLU四个基准测试，相比原生SDAR张量并行基线，解码吞吐量最高提升7.46倍，生成质量没有下降，甚至有1.7%的小幅提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注Methodology部分的输入布局和注意力掩码设计，以及实验部分的吞吐量和质量对比数据，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) rely on masked language modeling and bidirectional attention, which makes them incompatible with standard token-level speculative decoding, a widely used acceleration technique for autoregressive (AR) LLMs. The dynamic effective context across denoising steps in dLLMs cannot maintain temporally valid token-level contexts, preventing direct application of speculative verification and limiting further inference speed improvements.
summary_en.importance: SimSD provides a training-free, generalizable acceleration solution for dLLMs. It enables dLLMs to adopt the mature speculative decoding technique developed for AR models, while remaining compatible with existing acceleration methods such as blockwise decoding and KV cache, with practical value for dLLM deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: SimSD uses a plug-and-play attention masking strategy with two core designs: first, a dedicated input layout where each target generation position has two slots: one stores draft tokens from a smaller reference model as context, the other acts as a prediction slot for logit calculation. Second, a temporal causal attention mask that allows prediction slots to access corresponding reference context and other visible tokens at the current step, enabling verification of multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. The method requires no additional training and fits directly into existing dLLM decoding pipelines.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on SDAR family dLLMs across four benchmarks: GSM8K, MBPP, TriviaQA, and MMLU. Compared to the vanilla SDAR baseline with tensor parallelism, SimSD delivers up to 7.46× higher decoding throughput, with no generation quality degradation and even a 1.7% minor improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the input layout and attention mask design in the Methodology section, as well as throughput and quality comparison results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读算法和接受率分析；若无需重训就能稳定加速 dLLM，会改变对 diffusion LM serving 成本的估计。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and acceptance-rate analysis; if it works without retraining, it changes the serving-cost prior for diffusion LMs.

paper.title: DREAM-S: Speculative Decoding with Searchable Drafting and Target-Aware Refinement for Multimodal Generation
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) has proven to be an effective technique for accelerating autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) however, its application to vision-language models (VLMs) remains relatively unexplored. We propose~\textit{DREAM-S}, a novel SD framework designed specifically for fast and efficient decoding in VLMs. DREAM-S leverages a neural architecture search (NAS) framework with target-aware supernet training to automatically identify both the optimal interaction str

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 VLM 自回归生成中的 speculative decoding 适配问题：文本 LLM 上的草稿模型加速方法不能直接迁移到多模态场景，因为视觉 token、文本 token、跨模态交互和目标模型中间表示都会影响草稿 token 的接受率与推理延迟。
