summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接影响有限，更偏推理加速与部署效率。但它有一个有用信号：VLM 的解码加速不能只看小草稿模型的语言建模能力，还要考虑视觉输入剪枝、目标模型中间层信息复用、以及硬件上的真实延迟。对于训练侧，草稿模型蒸馏如何利用目标 VLM 的跨模态中间表示，也可作为多模态模型压缩和协同推理的参考。
summary.technical_approach: DREAM-S 把 VLM speculative decoding 中的草稿模型设计表述为一个 NAS 问题。搜索对象不只是草稿模型宽度或深度，还包括输入剪枝比例、草稿模型与目标模型的连接方式、以及不同硬件平台上的速度—接受率权衡。训练侧使用 two-phase progressive training：先 warm-up 训练完整草稿模型，再进入可搜索配置训练。另一个核心模块是 adaptive intermediate feature distillation。它从目标 VLM 的中间层动态选择更有信息量的隐藏状态，用注意力熵等信号指导选择，再通过交叉注意力把目标模型的中间表示注入草稿模型。这样做的目标是提高草稿 token 与目标模型输出的一致性，而不是单纯缩小草稿模型。与常规 speculative decoding 相比，DREAM-S 的主要差别在于：它把多模态输入剪枝、中间层蒸馏、草稿—目标交互策略和硬件约束放在同一个搜索框架里优化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaVA-v1.6-Vicuna-7B/13B、SmolVLM-2B、Pixtral-12B 等 VLM，并在多类视觉语言生成任务上比较常规解码和已有 speculative decoding 方法。给出的主要结果是最高可达到 3.85× 加速，同时保持较高接受率。消融重点应在三个部分：NAS 搜索出的草稿配置是否优于手工配置；中间层特征蒸馏是否提升 token 接受长度；输入剪枝和交互策略在不同目标模型、不同硬件上的选择是否稳定。给定内容未提供完整表格数字，因此不能进一步确认平均加速、质量退化幅度和各消融项的独立贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看 Methodology 中 Figure 2，对齐训练和推理流程；再看 TPPT、AIFD、cross-attention feature reuse 的具体实现；实验部分重点看速度提升表、接受率、质量指标和消融。无需细读任务背景和 VLM 应用介绍。若只关心 LLM pretrain，可把它作为“多模态 speculative decoding 中草稿模型如何训练”的案例，而不是预训练方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: DREAM-S targets speculative decoding for autoregressive VLM generation. Draft-model acceleration methods designed for text-only LLMs do not transfer cleanly to VLMs, because visual tokens, text tokens, cross-modal interactions, and target-model intermediate states all affect both acceptance rate and latency.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its useful lesson for foundation-model researchers is that VLM decoding acceleration needs more than a small language draft model. Visual input pruning, reuse of target-model intermediate representations, and hardware-aware latency all matter. The distillation design is also relevant to multimodal compression: the draft model is trained to exploit cross-modal hidden states from the target model, not just to imitate final logits.
summary_en.technical_approach: DREAM-S formulates VLM speculative decoding as a neural architecture search problem. The search space includes draft-model configuration, input pruning ratio, and interaction strategy between draft and target models, with the objective tied to the target hardware. Training uses a two-phase progressive procedure: first training the full draft model, then training searchable configurations. The second key component is adaptive intermediate feature distillation. Target-model middle-layer features are selected dynamically, guided by signals such as attention entropy, and injected into the draft model through cross-attention. This is intended to improve draft-token agreement with the target model and extend accepted token runs. Compared with standard speculative decoding, the main difference is that DREAM-S jointly optimizes multimodal input pruning, intermediate-feature supervision, draft-target coupling, and hardware-aware speed.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers LLaVA-v1.6-Vicuna-7B/13B, SmolVLM-2B, and Pixtral-12B on multiple vision-language generation tasks. The reported headline result is up to 3.85× speedup over conventional decoding while maintaining high acceptance rates. The important ablations are the NAS-selected draft configuration versus manual choices, the contribution of adaptive intermediate feature distillation, and the stability of pruning and interaction choices across target VLMs and hardware settings. The provided content does not include the full experimental tables, so average speedup, quality degradation, and per-component gains cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with Figure 2 and the Methodology section to understand the training and inference pipeline. Then read the details of TPPT, AIFD, and cross-attention-based feature reuse. In the experiments, focus on latency, acceptance rate, quality preservation, and ablations. The application background can be skipped. For LLM pretraining researchers, this is best read as a case study in training multimodal draft models for speculative decoding.

recommendation.zh: 多模态推测解码的工程化落地方案，注意力熵引导蒸馏的设计可参考，重点看§3的NAS搜索空间和实验结果
recommendation.en: Engineering implementation of multimodal speculative decoding; the attention-entropy guided distillation design is worth referencing, focus on §3 search space and experimental results

paper.title: Speculative Pipeline Decoding: Higher-Accruacy and Zero-Bubble Speculation via Pipeline Parallelism
paper.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates low-concurrency LLM inference by employing a draft-then-verify paradigm. However, mainstream methods typically rely on multi-token prediction, which introduces escalating prediction difficulty and serial drafting latency. To address these, we propose Speculative Pipeline Decoding (SPD), a groundbreaking framework that unlocks the true potential of pipeline parallelism. By partitioning the target LLM into $n$ pipeline stages, SPD allows LLM to process $n$ tok

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是单序列低并发场景下 speculative decoding 的两个结构性瓶颈。第一，主流方法依赖 multi-token drafting，越往后预测越依赖草稿模型自己生成的浅层、未验证状态，误差会沿 draft length 累积，接受率快速下降。第二，draft 与 verify 往往仍有串行依赖，目标模型会等待草稿，或者草稿模块本身要串行生成多个 token，导致加速被 drafting latency 吃掉。作者想解决的不是再把 draft 头做得更强，而是换一个执行范式：把 target LLM 改成 pipeline 形式，让不同 token 同时处在不同深度，再只预测“下一个需要填进流水线的 token”，从而避免传统 speculative decoding 中 draft length 带来的长程衰减和等待开销。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练，而在推理执行范式。它给出的启发是：speculation 不一定要围绕“多预测几个未来 token”来设计，也可以围绕“如何持续喂满 target model 的执行流水线”来设计。这个视角把 speculative decoding 从 token-level lookahead 改成 pipeline occupancy optimization。对 serving 和系统研究更有价值，对训练侧的启发相对有限，但如果未来训练时就考虑中间层可预测性、分层特征可聚合性，可能会反过来影响模型结构和中间表示设计。论文的贡献量级属于中等偏上：提出了一个清楚的新框架，也给了比 EAGLE-3 更好的理论速度指标，但目前主要还是 inference-side 方法，且收益依赖 pipeline 切分和实现条件。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心有两部分。第一部分是把目标模型切成 n 个 pipeline stages。这样在任一 cycle 内，模型不是让一个 token 走完整个网络，而是让 n 个 token 分别位于不同深度并行推进。为了避免 bubble，每个 cycle 都需要有一个新 token 被送入第一阶段。SPD 的 speculation module 就负责预测这个 token。

第二部分是 speculation module 的设计。作者没有像 PPSD 那样只用第一阶段的浅层 hidden state 做 early exit，而是做 multi-depth feature aggregation：收集当前流水线中各 token 在不同 stage 的部分特征，以及已经验证 token 的完整特征，再把这些信息聚合后预测下一个 token。这样做的关键原因是，预测时不再只依赖某个很浅的局部表示，而是利用了“多 token、多深度”的上下文切片。论文强调一个重要性质：由于流水线长度固定为 n，预测所依赖的不完整特征的缺失程度被上界在常数 n 内，不会像传统 multi-token drafting 那样随着 draft length 增长而无界恶化。

另一个关键设计是 zero mutual waiting。常规 speculative decoding 中，草稿往往要等 target model 产出某些状态后才能继续。SPD 把 speculation module 的执行窗口前移，只基于当前 cycle 的 pipeline 输入状态来预测下一 token，而不是等本 cycle 输出出来后再预测。这样 speculation 和 target pipeline step 可以严格并行。代价是预测时可用信息更早、更少，理论上更难；作者用更强的 multi-depth aggregation 来补偿，并指出因为该模块延迟被 target step 完全掩蔽，所以可以把 speculation network 做得更深而不增加端到端时延。

论文还提出了 Equivalent Acceptance Length 这一指标，用来替代传统 acceptance length。原因是 pipeline speculative decoding 里存在初始化和 flush penalty，简单统计接受 token 数会高估真实收益。这个指标把 rejection 后流水线清空、重新填充的代价算进去，更接近理论吞吐提升。
summary.experiments:
实验基于 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B，评测覆盖 MT-Bench、GSM8K、HumanEval。摘要和引言里给出的主结论是：SPD 在 equivalent acceptance length 上与主流方法相当或更高，并且在大多数设置下理论 speedup 超过 EAGLE-3。全文可见作者重点不是宣称绝对 wall-clock 全面领先，而是先证明这种 pipeline speculation 在接受长度和理论吞吐上成立。

从实验设计看，值得注意的点有几个。第一，作者专门把 SPD 与 PPSD 对比，说明只看第一阶段浅层特征会明显损伤接受率，且 stage 数增加后更难扩展；这支撑了 multi-depth aggregation 的必要性。第二，作者把 zero-bubble 并行执行作为核心卖点，因此消融里应重点看 speculation module 是否真的被完全 latency hidden，以及不同模块深度对端到端速度的影响。第三，Equivalent Acceptance Length 这个指标本身也是实验的一部分，因为它解释了为什么某些方法表面 acceptance 高，但真实 pipeline speedup 并不高。

从已给出的数字看，论文没有在你提供的片段里列出完整表格数值，但明确声称 SPD 在多数设置下超过 EAGLE-3 的理论加速，并保持可比的等效接受长度。若精读全文，建议重点核对：不同 pipeline stage 数 n 下的收益曲线、rejection flush 带来的损失、4B 与 9B 模型上趋势是否一致、以及 wall-clock 与理论 speedup 的偏差有多大。这些决定方法是否只是分析上成立，还是工程上也稳。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐行推公式。先看 Introduction，把作者批评现有 speculative decoding 的两点抓住：long-range decay 和 mutual waiting。然后直接看方法图，理解“不是一次猜多个 token，而是每个 cycle 猜一个 token 去填流水线”。如果这个执行图看懂了，后面的设计就顺了。

接着重点看三处。第一，multi-depth feature aggregation 的输入到底包含哪些 token、哪些 stage 的特征，聚合方式是否足够轻量。第二，zero mutual waiting 的时间线图，确认 speculation 用的是 pipeline input state 而不是 output state。第三，Equivalent Acceptance Length 的定义和推导，这决定了作者的速度结论是否公平。

实验部分建议优先看：SPD vs EAGLE-3 vs PPSD 的主表；不同 stage 数、不同 speculation module 深度的消融；理论 speedup 与真实 latency 的对应关系。预计 30 到 45 分钟可以抓住主要内容。如果只想判断是否值得后续跟进，看方法图、指标定义、主结果表就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two structural limits of speculative decoding in low-concurrency, single-sequence inference. First, mainstream methods rely on multi-token drafting, where later draft tokens are conditioned on shallow and unverified states produced by the draft process itself. This creates compounding error and sharply lowers acceptance as draft length grows. Second, drafting and verification still introduce waiting: either the target model idles while drafts are produced, or the draft path itself is partially serial. SPD reframes the problem. Instead of predicting a long future chunk, it keeps a pipelined target model continuously fed by predicting only the next token needed to fill the pipeline.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is a meaningful inference-side idea for foundation model researchers. The main value is conceptual: speculation does not have to be framed as longer lookahead in token space; it can be framed as maintaining pipeline occupancy in execution space. That shift is useful for serving systems and may eventually feed back into model design if intermediate representations are trained to be more predictable or more aggregatable across depths. The contribution is moderate but real: a clean new decoding framework, a better metric for pipelined speculation, and stronger theoretical speedup than EAGLE-3 in most reported settings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SPD has two central components. First, the target LLM is partitioned into n pipeline stages. Instead of running one token through all layers, the model processes n tokens concurrently at different depths. To avoid bubbles, each cycle must inject one new token into stage 1. The speculation module predicts exactly that token.

Second, the speculation module uses multi-depth feature aggregation. Unlike PPSD, which only uses shallow hidden states from the first stage, SPD collects partially processed features from tokens currently inside the pipeline, together with fully processed features from already verified tokens. These features are aggregated to predict the next token. The key argument is that prediction is grounded in richer and better-aligned internal states from the target model itself, rather than in a shallow early-exit view. The paper emphasizes a bounded-difficulty property: because the pipeline length is fixed at n, the incompleteness of the available features is bounded by a constant, instead of growing unbounded with draft length as in conventional multi-token speculation.

A second key design is zero mutual waiting. SPD shifts the speculation window forward so that the speculation module runs from the current pipeline input state, not from the output state after the current pipeline step. This allows speculation and target execution to run strictly in parallel. The trade-off is that prediction is made from earlier, less complete information. The authors compensate with stronger multi-depth aggregation and argue that, since speculation latency is fully hidden behind the target pipeline step, the speculation network can be made deeper without increasing end-to-end latency.

The paper also introduces Equivalent Acceptance Length, a metric intended to better reflect pipelined speculative decoding. Standard acceptance length can overestimate gains because it ignores pipeline fill and flush costs after rejection. The new metric explicitly accounts for initialization overhead and rejection penalties, making the theoretical speedup analysis more faithful.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are conducted on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, evaluated on MT-Bench, GSM8K, and HumanEval. The main reported result is that SPD achieves comparable or better equivalent acceptance length and surpasses EAGLE-3 in theoretical speedup under most settings. The paper appears more careful about theoretical throughput than about claiming universal wall-clock dominance.

Several experimental choices matter. First, comparisons against PPSD are important because they isolate the value of multi-depth aggregation over shallow first-stage speculation. Second, the zero-bubble claim should be checked through ablations on speculation-module depth and whether its latency is truly hidden by the target pipeline step. Third, the proposed Equivalent Acceptance Length is itself part of the empirical story, since it explains why raw acceptance can be misleading in pipelined settings.

The excerpt provided does not include full tables, so the exact numbers are not all visible here. Still, the paper explicitly claims better theoretical acceleration than EAGLE-3 in most settings while maintaining comparable effective acceptance. When reading the full paper, the most important details to verify are: how gains scale with the number of pipeline stages, how severe flush penalties are after rejection, whether trends are consistent between 4B and 9B models, and how close wall-clock speedup is to the theoretical estimate.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Do not spend time on every derivation. Start with the introduction and lock onto the two critiques of prior speculative decoding: long-range decay and mutual waiting. Then go straight to the method figure. The key mental model is simple: SPD does not guess many future tokens at once; it predicts one token per cycle to keep the pipeline full.

Then focus on three parts. First, inspect exactly which token states and which stage features are used in multi-depth aggregation, and whether the aggregation module stays lightweight. Second, read the execution timeline for zero mutual waiting and confirm that speculation uses pipeline input states rather than output states. Third, read the definition of Equivalent Acceptance Length carefully; much of the speedup claim depends on this metric being the right one.

In experiments, prioritize the main comparison table against EAGLE-3 and PPSD, the ablations over stage count and speculation depth, and the relationship between theoretical speedup and measured latency. Around 30 to 45 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea and judge whether it is worth deeper follow-up.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统图和 speedup 假设；若硬件利用率和 acceptance rate 同时成立，单请求 serving 的 pipeline prior 要改。
recommendation.en: Read the system diagram and speedup assumptions; if utilization and acceptance both hold, this changes the prior on pipeline parallelism for single-request serving.

paper.title: Draft-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Draft Models
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by pairing a target model with a lightweight draft model whose proposed tokens are verified in parallel. A common way to build draft models, like EAGLE3 or DFlash is supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on target-generated trajectories. However, we observe that SFT quickly plateaus: the draft model's acceptance length on test data stops improving. The reason is an offline-to-inference mismatch: In SFT, the drafter learns from fixed target-g

summary.core_problem: Draft-OPD 解决的是训练型 speculative decoding draft model 的离线训练瓶颈。常规 SFT 学的是 target model 生成的固定轨迹，但推理时 draft model 的接受长度由它自己提出的 token block 决定，两者状态分布不一致，导致继续 SFT 很快进入平台期。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练方向的直接关系不强，但对大模型推理效率和 post-train 信号设计有清晰启发。它指出 draft model 的训练目标不能只看 teacher-forced next-token matching，而要看 verification-time state distribution。这个观点和预训练中的 exposure bias、on-policy data、训练-推理分布差异是同一类问题。对做推测解码、轻量预测头、蒸馏和推理加速的人，方法价值较高。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Draft-OPD，即面向 speculative draft model 的 on-policy distillation。直接让 draft model 自己 rollout 不可行，因为 EAGLE 类或 DFlash 类 drafter 通常不是完整自回归模型，而是依赖 target model 上下文提出短 token span，单独生成会重复或退化。单纯 target-assisted rollout 也不够，因为 target 会丢弃 draft 的错误 token，最有训练价值的错误状态被抹掉。Draft-OPD 的做法是：先用 target-assisted rollout 保持续写稳定，同时记录 speculative verification 中暴露出来的错误位置；再从这些错误位置 replay drafting，让 target model 对相同的 draft-induced prefixes 打分；最后使用 acceptance-aware distillation objective，对 accepted tokens 和 rejected tokens 区分处理。accepted tokens 用来强化与 target 的可靠一致性，rejected tokens 用来集中修正限制接受长度的 draft-induced errors。
summary.experiments: 论文报告，离线 SFT 在初始 warm-up 后 accepted length 不再提升，继续在 OPD 数据上做 SFT 甚至可能降低接受长度。Draft-OPD 在 matched FLOPs 设置下，相比 EAGLE-3 提升 23%，相比 DFlash 提升 13%。在 thinking models 上实现超过 5 倍的 lossless acceleration。关键实验信号是 accepted length，而不是单纯 distillation loss；这符合 speculative decoding 的实际目标，因为更长的接受片段直接减少 target model 解码步数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30 分钟。重点看 Figure 1 和相关训练曲线，理解 SFT plateau 的证据。然后读方法部分的 error-position replay 和 acceptance-aware objective，这是论文的核心。实验部分重点看 matched FLOPs 对比、accepted length、端到端加速倍率，而不是只看 loss。若关注推理系统，可进一步看它如何接入 EAGLE-3 和 DFlash 风格 drafter。

summary_en.core_problem: Draft-OPD addresses a training mismatch in learned speculative draft models. Standard SFT trains the drafter on fixed target-generated trajectories, while speculative decoding evaluates the drafter on token blocks produced by its own policy. This offline-to-inference mismatch causes accepted length to plateau after a short SFT warm-up.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant to inference efficiency and distillation, with a useful connection to broader foundation-model training. It shows that matching the teacher under teacher-forced states is not enough when the deployment metric depends on student-induced states. This is the same class of issue as exposure bias and on-policy data collection, but studied in the concrete setting of speculative decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Draft-OPD, adapts on-policy distillation to speculative drafters. Naive draft-only rollouts are unstable because EAGLE-style or DFlash-style drafters are designed to propose short spans under target-model guidance, not to act as standalone autoregressive generators. Target-assisted rollouts are stable, but they erase the rejected draft tokens, which are exactly the states that limit acceptance. Draft-OPD keeps target-assisted rollout for stable continuation, records error positions exposed by speculative verification, replays drafting from those positions, and asks the target model to score the resulting draft-induced prefixes. The training objective is acceptance-aware: accepted tokens reinforce reliable agreement with the target, while rejected tokens focus learning on the errors that reduce accepted length.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that continued offline SFT stops improving accepted length after the initial warm-up, and in some settings can even reduce it on OPD data. Under matched FLOPs, Draft-OPD improves over EAGLE-3 by 23% and over DFlash by 13%. For thinking models, it achieves more than 5x lossless acceleration. The important metric is accepted length rather than distillation loss alone, because accepted length directly determines how many expensive target-model decoding steps are saved.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with Figure 1 and the SFT plateau analysis, since that motivates the method. Then read the error-position replay procedure and the acceptance-aware objective. In the experiments, focus on matched-FLOPs comparisons, accepted length, and end-to-end speedup. The implementation details are useful if the goal is to integrate the method with EAGLE-3 or DFlash-style speculative drafters.

recommendation.zh: 离线蒸馏失配这个诊断很可信；读方法里如何保留 on-policy 信号，值得在内部 draft 训练复现。
recommendation.en: The offline-distillation mismatch diagnosis is credible; read how they preserve on-policy signal and consider reproducing it for draft training.

paper.title: Cluster-Level Attention-Guided Parallel Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) enable parallel decoding by predicting all masked positions at each denoising step, yet existing training-free samplers usually decide which positions to commit at token-level granularity. We revisit this granularity and observe that reliable predictions often emerge as contiguous high-confidence spans, suggesting that the unit of parallel commitment can be larger than a single token. We first group adjacent high-confidence candidates into confidence-indu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 masked diffusion language model 的一个关键推理问题：在每个去噪步里，模型会同时给所有 masked 位置出预测，但解码器必须决定哪些位置现在就提交、哪些位置留到后面。已有 training-free sampler 大多把“提交单位”设成单个 token，再用置信度、熵、margin 或 token-level attention dependency 来控制激进程度。作者指出，这个粒度可能过细。实际去噪过程中，可靠预测常常不是孤立 token，而是连续出现的高置信 span；如果仍按 token 一个个提交，会浪费迭代步数，也会限制 MDLM 的并行潜力。于是论文把问题改写为：能否把连续高置信 span 作为并行提交单位，同时避免同一步里提交彼此仍强依赖、会产生联合不一致的 span。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在训练 recipe，而在新型语言建模范式的推理接口。MDLM 一直面临一个现实问题：理论上可并行，实际质量和速度之间很难同时拿到，很多收益被 sampler 吃掉了。这篇工作的价值在于，它没有改模型、没有再训练，而是重新定义了 MDLM 的“解码进度单位”，把 token-level scheduling 提升到 span/cluster-level scheduling。这个视角是有启发的，因为它说明 diffusion LM 的推理瓶颈不只是置信度估计是否准，还包括解码粒度是否和模型内部形成的局部结构对齐。对做 diffusion LM、any-order LM、masked LM 推理的人，这是一种值得继续追的方向：如果训练目标天然允许局部块状恢复，那么推理时按 token 调度可能并不匹配模型的生成动力学。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 CLAD，核心由三步组成。第一步，构造 confidence-induced clusters，简称 CIC。做法是先在当前去噪步对每个 masked 位置计算 token-level confidence，然后把相邻且都超过阈值的 masked 位置合并成一个最大连续段，作为一个 cluster。这里的设计很直接，但背后假设很明确：连续高置信位置往往共享局部上下文支持，适合作为一个整体提交。第二步，估计 cluster 之间的依赖冲突。作者不重新训练额外模块，而是复用同一次前向传播里的 self-attention map，把 token 间依赖聚合到 cluster 间，得到 inter-cluster dependency score。然后只保留“互为 strongest dependency”的边，构成一个较稀疏的 conflict graph。这个 mutual strongest 过滤很关键，因为如果把所有弱依赖都连边，图会过密，最后退化成过保守解码。第三步，在 conflict graph 上做 maximum-weight non-conflicting cluster selection，也就是选一组彼此不冲突、总权重最大的 CIC 并行提交。权重来自 cluster 的置信度或其聚合形式。这样做相当于把每一步的提交决策写成一个受依赖约束的组合优化问题，而不是独立 token 排序。与 DAPD、DAWN 这类 token-level dependency-aware 方法相比，CLAD 的区别不只是把 attention 用到 cluster 上，更重要的是它把“局部可靠性”和“全局兼容性”拆成两个层次：先定义 span 级候选，再做冲突消解，而不是直接在 token 图上做细粒度筛选。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类任务：数学推理和代码生成；模型来自 LLaDA 与 Dream 两个 MDLM 家族；共四个 benchmark。论文主结果是，在不改训练的前提下，CLAD 相对 Vanilla decoding 获得 1.77× 到 8.47× 的速度提升，同时多数设置下任务准确率保持大体可比。和 token-level dependency-aware baseline，如 DAPD、DAWN 相比，CLAD 在大多数评测设置里 throughput 更高。就论文给出的结论看，收益主要来自两点：一是 cluster-level commitment 明显减少了需要的 denoising iteration；二是 attention-derived compatibility 建模抑制了“每个 span 单看都对、一起提交却冲突”的质量损失。消融的重点应当包括：只做 CIC 不做 conflict filtering 时，速度会上去但质量更容易掉；只做 token-level dependency 而不做 cluster grouping，则并行度释放不足。作者还强调 conflict graph 的稀疏化是效率成立的条件，否则 cluster selection 的额外开销会侵蚀解码收益。摘要里没有列出更细的 benchmark 分项数字、阈值敏感性和不同序列长度下的曲线；这些需要回到正文表格和附录确认。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓住三个问题。第一，看 Introduction 和方法总览图，确认作者到底改了什么：不是训练目标，不是模型结构，而是解码调度粒度。第二，看 CIC 的定义和 conflict graph 的构造，重点理解 cluster 是如何从 token confidence 诱导出来的，以及 attention 依赖如何从 token 聚合到 cluster。这里决定了方法是否只是启发式拼接，还是有较清楚的结构假设。第三，看主表里 CLAD 对 Vanilla、DAPD、DAWN 的速度-精度权衡，尤其是不同模型家族上是否稳定。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若要继续深挖，建议重点看：阈值选择、cluster 长度分布、attention dependency 的定义、以及额外解码开销占比。这些决定方法能否迁移到更大模型或更长上下文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a central inference problem in masked diffusion language models: at each denoising step, the model predicts all masked positions, but the decoder must decide which predictions to commit now and which ones to defer. Existing training-free samplers mostly operate at token granularity, using confidence or token-level dependency signals to rank positions. The authors argue that this granularity is too fine. In practice, reliable predictions often emerge as contiguous high-confidence spans rather than isolated tokens. Committing them one token at a time wastes denoising steps and underuses the parallelism that MDLMs could offer. The paper therefore asks whether the commitment unit should be a span-level cluster, while still preventing jointly incompatible spans from being accepted in the same step.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not about pretraining recipe, but it matters for alternative language modeling paradigms. MDLMs are often attractive in theory because they allow parallel decoding, yet much of that advantage depends on the sampler. This work is useful because it reframes the decoding bottleneck: the issue is not only how to estimate confidence, but also whether the scheduling unit matches the local structure that emerges during denoising. For researchers working on diffusion LMs, masked LMs, or any-order generation, this is a meaningful systems-and-algorithm interface. If the model naturally recovers text in locally coherent chunks, token-wise scheduling may be a poor fit for the model’s generation dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, CLAD, has three main components. First, it builds confidence-induced clusters (CICs). At a denoising step, the decoder computes token-level confidence for masked positions and merges adjacent high-confidence masked tokens into maximal contiguous spans. Each span becomes a candidate update unit. The underlying assumption is simple but important: neighboring confident positions are often supported by the same local context and can be committed together. Second, CLAD estimates dependencies between clusters. Instead of training an auxiliary module, it reuses self-attention maps from the same forward pass, aggregates token-level interactions into inter-cluster dependency scores, and constructs a conflict graph. To keep the graph sparse, it retains only mutually strongest inter-cluster dependencies. This pruning is important; otherwise the graph becomes too dense and the decoder turns overly conservative. Third, CLAD selects a maximum-weight set of non-conflicting clusters for parallel commitment. Cluster weights come from aggregated confidence. This turns each denoising step into a constrained combinatorial selection problem rather than independent token ranking. Relative to token-level dependency-aware methods such as DAPD and DAWN, the key difference is not merely using attention at cluster level. The deeper change is the two-stage decomposition: define locally reliable span candidates first, then resolve global compatibility among them.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers mathematical reasoning and code generation, using pretrained MDLMs from the LLaDA and Dream families on four benchmarks. The main result is a 1.77× to 8.47× speedup over vanilla decoding while keeping task accuracy broadly comparable in most settings. Against token-level dependency-aware baselines such as DAPD and DAWN, CLAD improves throughput in most evaluated cases. The reported gains appear to come from two sources: cluster-level commitment reduces the number of denoising iterations, and attention-based compatibility modeling limits the quality drop that would otherwise come from aggressively committing multiple spans at once. The key ablation to look for is the separation between the two ingredients: using CICs without conflict filtering should improve speed but hurt accuracy more, while token-level dependency modeling without cluster grouping should leave parallelism underexploited. The paper also stresses that sparsifying the conflict graph is necessary for efficiency; otherwise the overhead of cluster selection would eat into the decoding gains. The abstract does not provide finer benchmark-level numbers or sensitivity analyses, so those need to be checked in the main tables and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, focus on three things. First, read the introduction and method overview to pin down the actual intervention: this is a decoding-policy paper, not a training-objective or architecture paper. Second, inspect how CICs are defined and how token-level attention is aggregated into cluster-level conflicts. That is where the method either becomes a coherent structural proposal or just a heuristic stack. Third, check the main speed-versus-accuracy tables against Vanilla, DAPD, and DAWN, especially across both LLaDA and Dream models. A useful skim should take about 20 to 30 minutes. If you want to go deeper, prioritize threshold sensitivity, cluster length statistics, the exact dependency definition, and the fraction of runtime spent on the extra graph construction and selection steps. Those details determine whether the method is likely to transfer to larger models or longer contexts.

recommendation.zh: MDLM 推理加速的巧妙设计，利用 attention map 做冲突检测很有启发，值得关注非自回归生成的同学一读。
recommendation.en: Clever design for MDLM inference acceleration; using attention maps for conflict detection is inspiring. Worth reading for those interested in non-autoregressive generation.

institutions: Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: BlockBatch: Multi-Scale Consensus Decoding for Efficient Diffusion Language Model Inference
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising multiple token positions in parallel, offering an attractive alternative to strictly autoregressive decoding. In practice, however, block-wise dLLM inference exposes a difficult granularity trade-off: small blocks preserve local conditioning but require many denoising steps, whereas large blocks expose more parallelism but can make premature commitments and accumulate cache error. Existing acceleration methods typically cho

summary.core_problem: Diffusion语言模型推理中block-wise解码面临粒度权衡：小块保持局部条件但需要多步，大块增加并行但容易过早承诺并积累缓存误差。
summary.importance: 提出BlockBatch，一个无需训练的在线推理框架，通过多尺度共识解码利用不同块大小的互补性，属于扩散LM推理效率创新。
summary.technical_approach: 核心发现：不同块大小会产生相关但不完全相同的KV-cache轨迹——分支通常共享初始前缀，在语义关键位置分叉，然后在语法轻量级token上重新一致。BlockBatch同时执行多个块大小分支，并通过共识解码在token级别合并它们。
summary.experiments: 无需训练，在线推理框架。实验未给出具体模型参数和基线对比数据（摘要被截断）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自Xiaoyou Wu, Cheng-Jhih Shih, Binfei Ji, Yong Liu, Yingyan Celine Lin，机构信息未明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Block-wise diffusion LLM inference faces a granularity trade-off: small blocks preserve local conditioning but need many steps; large blocks enable more parallelism but risk premature commitments and cache error accumulation.
summary_en.importance: Proposes BlockBatch, a training-free online inference framework that leverages the complementarity of different block sizes via multi-scale consensus decoding — an innovation in diffusion LM inference efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Key insight: different block sizes induce related but non-identical KV-cache trajectories — branches typically share an initial prefix, bifurcate at semantically decisive positions, and later agree on syntactically lightweight tokens. BlockBatch executes multiple block-size branches simultaneously and merges them at the token level via consensus decoding.
summary_en.experiments: Training-free online inference framework. Specific model parameters and baseline comparison data not fully provided (abstract truncated).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors: Xiaoyou Wu, Cheng-Jhih Shih, Binfei Ji, Yong Liu, Yingyan Celine Lin; institutional affiliation not explicitly stated.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM推理加速的新视角，核心insight是不同block大小的KV-cache轨迹有共享结构，共识解码思路值得关注，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: A novel perspective on diffusion LM inference acceleration — the core insight that KV-cache trajectories across block sizes share structure is worth understanding; read the method section only.

paper.title: Light Interaction: Training-Free Inference Acceleration for Interactive Video World Models
paper.abstract: Interactive video world models generate video chunk by chunk in response to user-controlled camera movements, enabling applications such as real-time game simulation, virtual scene navigation, and embodied AI training. However, scaling to long interactive trajectories is prohibitively expensive due to growing context memory, quadratic attention complexity, and repeated denoising steps. We present Light Interaction, a training-free inference acceleration framework for interactive video world mode

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式视频 world model 在长轨迹生成中因上下文增长、注意力二次复杂度和重复去噪导致的推理过慢问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率工作，不是预训练方法论文；但它对长上下文生成系统里的自适应计算、缓存复用和稀疏注意力有一些可迁移的系统直觉。
summary.technical_approach: 提出训练无关的加速框架 Light Interaction。核心包括三部分：按轨迹状态自适应管理上下文；在相机回访熟悉区域时复用早期去噪输出；结合软硬件协同的 3D block sparse attention 与融合 kernel，降低长轨迹交互生成成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调这是 interactive video world models 的 inference-only acceleration，目标场景是实时游戏模拟、场景导航和 embodied AI 训练。未给出具体模型、加速倍数和质量损失，需要看系统表和 latency-quality tradeoff。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses slow inference in interactive video world models caused by growing context, quadratic attention, and repeated denoising over long trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it offers transferable systems intuition on adaptive compute, cache reuse, and sparse attention for long-context generative systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Light Interaction, a training-free acceleration framework. It combines adaptive context management, denoising-cache reuse when revisiting familiar regions, and hardware-software co-designed 3D block sparse attention with fused kernels.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames it as inference-only acceleration for interactive video world models in real-time simulation and navigation settings. It does not provide exact speedups, quality tradeoffs, or model details, so the systems tables are the main thing to inspect.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 预训练关系不大，但如果你关心长上下文生成系统，只看缓存复用和自适应上下文两点，别花时间读完整方法。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to LLM pretraining, but if you care about long-context generative systems, only inspect the cache-reuse and adaptive-context ideas; the rest is mostly systems detail.

paper.title: Domino: Decoupling Causal Modeling from Autoregressive Drafting in Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them in parallel with the target model. However, its practical speedup is constrained by the trade-off between draft quality and drafting cost: autoregressive drafters model causal dependencies among draft tokens but incur sequential overhead, while parallel drafters reduce drafting cost but weaken intra-block dependency modeling. In this paper, we propose Domino, a speculative decoding framework that decoup

summary.core_problem: Speculative decoding 的实际加速受 draft 质量和 draft 成本之间的矛盾限制：自回归 draft 质量好但串行慢，并行 draft 快但块内因果依赖弱。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法改进。论文试图把因果依赖建模从昂贵的自回归 draft 执行中拆出来，从而在保持并行 draft 低成本的同时恢复一部分 causal consistency。
summary.technical_approach: Domino 先用并行 draft backbone 为整个 token block 产生初始分布，再用轻量 Domino head 注入 prefix-dependent 的因果信息来细化这些分布。训练上引入 base-anchored curriculum：先强化并行 backbone，再逐步把优化目标转向因果正确的 refinement，以稳定 teacher-forced causal encoding。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、目标模型、draft block size、benchmark 和速度提升数字。可确认的实验主张是 Domino 被用于 speculative decoding，并针对 AR drafter 与 parallel drafter 的质量/成本折中进行对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Speculative decoding is limited by a quality-cost trade-off: autoregressive drafters model intra-block causality but are sequential, while parallel drafters are cheap but weaker at causal dependency modeling.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method. Domino tries to separate causal modeling from expensive autoregressive draft execution so that parallel drafting can retain part of the dependency structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: Domino first uses a parallel draft backbone to produce preliminary distributions for the whole block, then applies a lightweight Domino head to refine them with prefix-dependent causal information. A base-anchored curriculum first strengthens the parallel backbone and then gradually shifts optimization toward causally correct refinement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, target models, block sizes, benchmarks, or exact speedups. The stated comparison is against the usual autoregressive and parallel drafter trade-off in speculative decoding.

recommendation.zh: 作为 serving 备查即可；关键看 Domino head 是否真低成本，摘要里的速度收益证据还不够。
recommendation.en: Keep it as serving literature; the key question is whether the Domino head is truly cheap, and the abstract does not yet show enough speed evidence.

paper.title: SGMD: Score Gradient Matching Distillation for Few-Step Video Diffusion Distillation
paper.abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) is a widely used paradigm for accelerating inference in few-step video diffusion models. However, DMD-style video distillation faces two coupled challenges: the fake score must track a continuously evolving generator, making training costly when frequent updates are required, while reverse-KL-style matching can be mode-seeking and conservative for preserving strong motion dynamics. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{Score Gradient Matching Distil

summary.core_problem: DMD-style video diffusion distillation has two coupled issues: fake score must track evolving generator (high training cost), and reverse-KL matching is mode-seeking/conservative for motion dynamics.
summary.importance: Method innovation: Score Gradient Matching Distillation (SGMD) as a new distillation paradigm for few-step video diffusion models.
summary.technical_approach: Directly optimizes fake score toward teacher score, using teacher stop-gradient Fisher as stable distribution-matching objective. Dual potentials: negative-residual (NR) for outer-loop correction and residual-contraction (RC) for inner-loop tracking.
summary.experiments: Empirically outperforms DMD2. Authors from Chinese Academy of Sciences, CUHK, Beihang, with Dahua Lin (CUHK) on the author list.
summary.authors_note: Chinese Academy of Sciences, CUHK (Dahua Lin), Beihang University

summary_en.core_problem: DMD-style video diffusion distillation suffers from costly tracking of evolving generator and conservative reverse-KL matching that suppresses motion dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: Score Gradient Matching Distillation (SGMD), a new distillation paradigm for few-step video diffusion acceleration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Direct fake score optimization toward teacher via stop-gradient Fisher matching objective. Dual potentials: negative-residual (NR) for outer-loop correction and residual-contraction (RC) for inner-loop tracking.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms DMD2 empirically. Author list includes Dahua Lin (CUHK).
summary_en.authors_note: Chinese Academy of Sciences, CUHK (Dahua Lin), Beihang University

recommendation.zh: 视频diffusion蒸馏方法，distillation机制对推理加速有参考价值，但核心应用域是视频生成，LLM研究员仅需知晓概念。
recommendation.en: Video diffusion distillation method. The distillation mechanism has some transfer value for inference acceleration but the domain is video generation — LLM researchers only need conceptual awareness.

paper.title: SoftCap: Soft-Budget Control for Diffusion Transformer Acceleration
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve strong visual quality, but their iterative denoising process requires many costly Transformer evaluations. Training-free acceleration methods reduce this cost by caching, forecasting, or verifying intermediate features, yet the runtime decision of when to execute a Full step is often driven by fixed schedules or hand-tuned thresholds. We propose \textbf{SoftCap}, a training-free control layer for cache-based DiT inference. SoftCap couples a Trajectory Drift

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散Transformer（DiT）的免训练推理加速方法依赖固定调度或人工调优阈值触发全步计算，无法在给定计算预算下平衡速度与生成质量
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出免训练的软预算控制机制，为迭代生成模型的动态推理调度提供了可迁移的设计思路
summary.technical_approach: 原创方法，包含两个核心模块：轨迹漂移观测器通过轻量隐状态统计估计缓存风险，软预算PI控制器根据实际计算消耗相对于参考配置动态调整全步触发阈值，预算为软上限而非强制固定全步数
summary.experiments: 在FLUX.1-dev模型上测试，同计算量级下相比SpeCa方法，ImageReward从0.967提升至0.981，原文摘要截断，完整延迟优化数据未给出

summary_en.core_problem: Existing training-free acceleration methods for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) rely on fixed schedules or hand-tuned thresholds to trigger full-step computation, failing to balance speed and generation quality under a given compute budget
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a training-free soft-budget control mechanism that provides transferable design insights for dynamic inference scheduling of iterative generative models
summary_en.technical_approach: Original method with two core modules: a Trajectory Drift Observer estimates cache risk via lightweight hidden-state statistics, and a Soft-Budget PI Controller dynamically adjusts the full-step triggering threshold based on actual compute consumption relative to a reference profile, with the budget acting as a soft ceiling instead of a mandatory fixed number of full steps
summary_en.experiments: Tested on FLUX.1-dev, improves ImageReward from 0.967 to 0.981 over SpeCa at a comparable compute level, the abstract is truncated and full latency optimization data is not provided

recommendation.zh: 软预算控制的动态调度思路可迁移至扩散LM推理优化，无需读全文，重点看核心方法设计即可
recommendation.en: The dynamic scheduling idea of soft-budget control is transferable to diffusion LM inference acceleration, no need to read the full paper, just check the core method design

paper.title: RT-Lynx: Putting the GEMM Sparsity In a Right Way for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve strong performance in image generation but incur substantial inference costs. While prior work has reduced this cost via quantization and distillation, semi-structured sparsity, which can nearly halve FLOPs, remains underexplored. A key reason is that most existing approaches focus on weight sparsification, and pruning 50% of the weights can remove critical model capacity and degrade generation quality. Our study, however, shows that DiT activations are intri

summary.core_problem: 降低 Diffusion Transformer 图像生成推理中 GEMM 的计算成本，同时避免权重剪枝带来的生成质量损失。
summary.importance: 这是 DiT 推理加速工作，贡献在于把 N:M semi-structured sparsity 的重点从权重转向 activation，并配套 CUDA kernel。它对 LLM 预训练不直接相关，但 activation sparsity 的测量和 kernel 设计对大模型推理系统有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: RT-Lynx 观察到 DiT activation 天然更稀疏，且比权重更能承受 N:M semi-structured sparsification。方法在 activation 上施加 N:M 稀疏化，并加入 error compensation 减少精度损失，同时实现针对该模式优化的 CUDA kernel。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是图像生成中的 Diffusion Transformer。摘要报告其在线性层平均最高达到 1.55 倍加速；具体模型规模、数据集、FID 或人评指标、baseline 细节在所给摘要中未完整列出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets GEMM cost reduction for Diffusion Transformer image generation while avoiding the quality loss caused by weight sparsification.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-acceleration paper for DiTs. Its contribution is to shift N:M semi-structured sparsity from weights to activations and to provide matching CUDA kernels. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the activation-sparsity measurement and kernel design are relevant to large-model serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: RT-Lynx argues that DiT activations are intrinsically sparse and more robust to N:M semi-structured sparsification than weights. It applies N:M sparsity to activations, adds error-compensation techniques to reduce quality loss, and implements optimized CUDA kernels for the resulting sparse GEMM pattern.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are on Diffusion Transformers for image generation. The abstract reports up to 1.55x average speedup in linear layers; the provided text does not include complete model sizes, datasets, generation metrics, or baseline details.

recommendation.zh: 作为效率信号看 activation 稀疏性即可；生成模型结论不能直接外推到 LLM，但 kernel 思路可备查。
recommendation.en: Use it as an activation-sparsity signal; the DiT result does not transfer directly to LLMs, but the kernel idea is worth filing.

paper.title: Dynamic Video Generation: Shaping Video Generation Across Time and Space
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved impressive performance in video generation, but their iterative denoising process remains computationally expensive due to the large number of tokens processed at each timestep. Recently, progressive resolution sampling has emerged as a promising acceleration approach by reducing latent resolution in early stages. However, scaling this idea to video generation remains challenging, as the additional temporal dimension introduces diverse spatio-temporal demands acros

summary.core_problem: 降低视频扩散模型采样成本，尤其是每个 denoising step 都处理大量时空 token 带来的推理开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成推理加速。它不改变预训练目标，但动态分配时空计算的思想对大规模生成模型 serving 和 token 预算控制有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: DVG 将 progressive resolution sampling 扩展到视频场景，不只压缩单一空间维度，而是根据内容在时间和空间两维动态选择加速策略。方法强调无需手工调参、无需重训练，并可与其他加速方法组合。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 HunyuanVideo 和 HunyuanVideo-1.5 上实现近无损加速，最高 7 倍；与其他方法结合时最高 18 倍。摘要未给出具体 benchmark、质量指标或显著性细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Jiao Tong University、South China University of Technology、Tsinghua University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the sampling cost of video diffusion models, where each denoising step processes a large number of spatiotemporal tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution for multimodal generation. It does not change pretraining objectives, but its dynamic spatiotemporal compute allocation is relevant to serving large generative models and managing token budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: DVG extends progressive resolution sampling to video by dynamically allocating computation across both time and space, rather than compressing only one dimension. It is content-aware, requires no manual tuning or retraining, and can be combined with other acceleration techniques.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims near-lossless acceleration on HunyuanVideo and HunyuanVideo-1.5, up to 7x speedup and up to 18x when combined with another method. Detailed benchmarks, metrics, and quality trade-offs are not available from the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University, South China University of Technology, and Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道但不必细读；看实验表确认质量指标，核心价值是生成模型推理预算的动态分配，不是预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing but not a full read; check the quality tables, since the useful signal is dynamic inference budgeting, not a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Draft Less, Retrieve More: Hybrid Tree Construction for Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by leveraging a draft-then-verify paradigm. To maximize the acceptance rate, recent methods construct expansive draft trees, which unfortunately incur severe VRAM bandwidth and computational overheads that bottleneck end-to-end speedups. While dynamic-depth pruning can reduce this latency by removing marginal branches, it also discards potentially valid candidates, preventing the acceptance rate from reaching the upper bound of

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章解决的是 speculative decoding 里一个很具体但很实际的矛盾：树状 draft 越大，target 一次验证能接受的 token 越多，但 draft 侧搜索、显存带宽和验证开销也越大，最终 wall-clock speedup 不一定更好；而动态剪枝虽然更快，却会把原本可能正确的分支一起剪掉，导致 mean accepted tokens 被静态大树的上界卡住。作者要解决的核心问题，是如何在不增加 target 额外前向、保持 lossless 的前提下，把“剪枝省下来的预算”重新利用起来，弥补动态树的覆盖损失。
summary.importance: 这项工作属于推理效率，不是预训练方法。但它对基座研究员仍有两层启发。第一，它把 speculative decoding 的优化目标从单纯“更聪明地剪枝”改成“预算重分配”，这个视角比继续调 pruning controller 更有工程含义。第二，它说明 retrieval 不一定只能做独立 drafter，也可以作为 tree construction 的补偿机制，和 parametric drafting 形成互补。贡献量级上，更像是对 EAGLE-3 / dynamic tree 这一条技术线的结构性改进，而不是新范式。若你关心 serving、长输出场景、KV-cache 带宽瓶颈，这篇比只看 acceptance rate 的论文更接近真实部署问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Graft，一个 training-free、lossless 的 prune-then-graft 混合树构造框架。它的逻辑分两步。

第一步是 pruning。作者沿用动态树思路，在若干 calibrated pruning checkpoints 上根据 draft 置信度决定是否提前截断某些低置信分支。这里的关键不是单纯减少计算，而是把被剪掉的节点数视为“释放出的候选预算”。论文强调，动态树方法的问题在于它们只能返回静态树的子树，因此无论 controller 多好，误剪都会让 accepted length 低于 dense tree 的理论上界。

第二步是 grafting。Graft 不把这些空出来的 slot 留空，也不继续往更深层做不确定的 autoregressive drafting，而是用 retrieval-based continuations 填进去。这样最终送给 target 验证的总预算与原始静态树相同，但候选来源从单一 parametric draft 变成“剪枝后的 parametric subtree + retrieval branches”。作者的论点是，retrieval 分支不受“必须是原静态树子树”的拓扑约束，因此可以补回 pruning 误伤掉的一部分有效 continuation，从而打破 latency-MAT 的原有 Pareto 前沿。

实现上，作者强调 GPU 友好。检索分支根植于当前 token，与自回归 drafting 并行准备；使用 GPU-resident adjacency matrix 存储和查询局部转移；通过 warm-up 初始化，并用 target 验证信号在线更新。这样做有三个目的：1）避免 CPU lookup 和同步开销；2）不改变标准 tree attention / verification 路径；3）不引入额外 target model forward。文章还特别指出，长上下文下这个设计更有利：一方面 AR drafting 更贵，剪枝收益更大；另一方面上下文更长会提供更多局部转移模式，提升 retrieval 命中率。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段主要是引言和方法动机，没有完整实验表格与具体数字，因此无法像正式精读那样列出 speedup、MAT、batch size、上下文长度、模型规模等精确结果。能从全文内容确认的实验主线有三条。第一，作者会把 Graft 与 dense static tree baseline（如 EAGLE-3）以及 pruning-only 动态树方法（DDD、SVIP、ECHO、TALON 一类）比较，核心指标应包括 mean accepted tokens、端到端延迟和实际 speedup，而不是只看 acceptance rate。第二，论文强调在“最终 verification budget 与静态树相同”的条件下比较，这一点很重要，因为它把收益归因于预算重分配，而不是单纯增加候选数。第三，作者声称方法在长上下文场景更有效，说明实验大概率覆盖不同输出长度或上下文长度，并分析 retrieval hit rate 随上下文增长的变化。

从方法设计推断，最值得关注的消融应包括：是否需要 calibrated pruning checkpoints；retrieval 分支数量与位置；GPU adjacency matrix 的 warm-up 和 online update 是否必要；以及 retrieval-only、pruning-only、hybrid 三者的对比。如果正文里有这些结果，它们会比单一总表更能说明方法成立的原因。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Figure 1 和 Introduction，把作者定义的 latency-MAT frontier 看明白，再读方法部分的 prune-then-graft 设计。真正的创新不在 retrieval 本身，而在“把 pruning 释放的预算显式回收并重投到另一类候选源”。如果只看摘要，很容易误以为这是又一个 retrieval-based SD；读正文时要注意它和 SAM-Decoding 这类 routing-only 方法的区别：Graft 是把 retrieval 直接并入 draft tree，而不是只用 retrieval 质量决定是否切换 drafter。

阅读时建议重点找四类内容：1）budget 保持不变时为何还能提高 MAT；2）GPU-resident adjacency matrix 如何避免 CPU 同步瓶颈；3）长上下文下 retrieval 命中率为何会上升；4）lossless 性质是如何保证的。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若只想抓工程价值，看实验总表、消融和实现细节即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in speculative decoding. Large draft trees can improve the mean accepted tokens per verification step, but they also increase draft-side search cost, VRAM bandwidth pressure, and verification overhead, so the end-to-end speedup often falls short of what acceptance metrics suggest. Dynamic pruning reduces latency, but it can only produce subtrees of the original dense tree, which means pruning mistakes permanently remove valid continuations and cap the achievable accepted length below the dense-tree upper bound. The core problem is how to reuse the computation budget freed by pruning so that latency improves without paying the usual acceptance penalty, all while remaining lossless and without extra target-model forward passes.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant for foundation-model researchers who care about deployment constraints. The main contribution is conceptual: it reframes dynamic tree construction from a pruning problem into a budget reallocation problem. That is more useful than simply tuning a better pruning controller, because it exposes where the wasted compute goes. A second useful point is that retrieval is not treated as a standalone drafter; it is used as a compensatory source of candidates that complements parametric drafting. In scope, this looks like a structural improvement over the EAGLE-3 and dynamic-tree line of work rather than a new decoding paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, called Graft, is a training-free and lossless hybrid tree construction framework built around a prune-then-graft strategy.

Step one is pruning. Similar to prior dynamic-tree methods, Graft uses calibrated confidence checkpoints to decide when low-confidence branches should be cut early. The important shift is interpretive: the removed branches are not treated merely as deleted candidates, but as released candidate budget. The paper argues that pruning-only methods are fundamentally limited because they must remain subtrees of the original static tree. As a result, any pruning error directly lowers coverage and therefore lowers the achievable accepted length.

Step two is grafting. Instead of leaving the freed slots empty, or spending them on deeper uncertain autoregressive drafting, Graft fills them with retrieval-based continuations. The total verification budget remains identical to that of the original static tree, but the candidate pool now becomes a hybrid of a pruned parametric subtree and retrieval branches. This matters because retrieval branches are not constrained to be descendants of the retained subtree, so they can recover some of the valid continuations lost to pruning and thereby move beyond the usual latency-MAT tradeoff.

Implementation is designed to be GPU-friendly. Retrieval branches are rooted at the current token and prepared in parallel with autoregressive drafting. A GPU-resident adjacency matrix stores local transition information, is initialized during warm-up, and updated online using target-model verification signals. This avoids CPU-side lookup and synchronization, preserves the standard tree-attention verification path, and does not require extra target forward passes. The paper also argues that the design becomes more attractive with long contexts: autoregressive drafting gets more expensive, making pruning more valuable, while longer contexts provide richer local transition patterns that improve retrieval hit rate.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full text is limited to the introduction and motivation, so the exact experimental numbers are not available here. Still, the evaluation structure is clear from the paper’s setup. First, Graft is positioned against dense static-tree baselines such as EAGLE-3 and against pruning-only dynamic-tree methods such as DDD, SVIP, ECHO, and related variants. The key metrics are expected to be mean accepted tokens, end-to-end latency, and realized speedup rather than acceptance rate alone. Second, the paper explicitly states that the final verification budget is kept identical to the original static tree, which is important because it isolates the gain as a consequence of budget reallocation rather than simply adding more candidates. Third, the authors claim stronger benefits under long-context generation, so the experiments likely vary prompt or output length and analyze how retrieval hit rate changes with context length.

The most informative ablations, if present in the main text, would be: the effect of calibrated pruning checkpoints, the number and placement of grafted retrieval branches, the necessity of warm-up and online updates for the GPU adjacency matrix, and comparisons among retrieval-only, pruning-only, and hybrid construction. Those would explain why the method works more clearly than a single aggregate speedup table.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim read, start with Figure 1 and the Introduction to understand the latency-MAT frontier the paper is trying to break. Then read the method section with one question in mind: how exactly is freed pruning budget converted into useful alternative candidates? The novelty is not retrieval by itself. It is the explicit coupling between pruning and retrieval under a fixed verification budget. That is also the main difference from routing-style methods such as SAM-Decoding, where retrieval quality is used only to decide whether to invoke a parametric drafter.

When reading, focus on four points: why MAT can improve even when the verification budget stays constant, how the GPU-resident adjacency matrix avoids CPU synchronization overhead, why retrieval becomes more effective with longer contexts, and how the lossless property is preserved. Estimated reading time: 20 to 30 minutes. If you only care about engineering value, prioritize the main experiment table, the ablations, and the implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 做推理加速的研究者重点看剪枝+检索互补的设计思路，基座研究员可了解该方向的权衡突破
recommendation.en: Inference acceleration researchers should focus on the pruning-retrieval complementary design; pretrain researchers can learn about this tradeoff breakthrough

paper.title: Multi-Token Residual Prediction
paper.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked token sequences, offering a tradeoff between parallelism and quality compared to autoregressive models. In current practice, the number of tokens decoded per step is controlled by a confidence threshold, and quality degrades monotonically as more tokens are denoised per step. We introduce Multi-token Residual Prediction (MRP), a lightweight module that enables dependency-aware multi-token denoising within a single bac

summary.core_problem: 解决 masked diffusion / block diffusion 语言模型在“每步解码更多 token”时质量单调下降的核心原因：同一步内多个 token 被同时解码，缺少它们之间的依赖建模；而如果为了依赖再跑一次 backbone，又会抵消并行带来的吞吐收益。论文要回答的是：能否在不增加 backbone 前向次数（或尽量少增加）的前提下，让 DLM 在单步内解码多个 token 仍保持依赖感知，从而改善质量-吞吐折中。
summary.importance: 这是偏推理侧的工作，但对“非 AR 语言建模范式”的落地很关键：它利用 DLM 相邻去噪步 logits 高相似性的训练动态性质，把‘多步迭代’的一部分计算用轻量模块近似/投机，从而把 DLM 的并行潜力更接近可用区间。对预训练研究的启发点在于：DLM 的时间步之间存在可学习的低秩/小残差结构，可能影响未来的训练目标设计（例如显式约束相邻步一致性、或把残差预测纳入训练以减少推理步数）。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Multi-token Residual Prediction (MRP)。关键观察：在 masked diffusion 的相邻去噪步 t 与 t-1 之间，如果只解开少量 token，backbone 输出 logits 的变化很小；定义残差 δ_t = ℓ_{t-1} - ℓ_t，其 RMS 幅度显著小于 ℓ_t 本身，因此“预测残差”比“重新预测完整 logits”容易。
实现上：一次 backbone 前向得到当前 logits ℓ_t 以及隐藏状态 h_t；MRP 模块从 h_t 直接预测下一步 logits 的残差 Δ（或等价的校正项），构造近似的 ℓ_{t-1} ≈ ℓ_t + MRP(h_t)。这样在同一次 backbone 前向里得到“下一步的近似 logits”，从而在一个 step 内可以多解一些 token，且更接近真正跑两次 backbone 的效果。
推理提供两种模式：
- direct decoding：直接用校正后的 logits 做多 token 解码，不做验证，追求更好的质量-速度曲线。
- speculative decoding：把 MRP 当作轻量 drafter，提出候选；下一次 backbone 前向做验证，接受的 token 不引入质量损失（代价是需要设计接受/拒绝规则与对齐到 DLM 的去噪流程）。
训练上使用“为残差量身定制的目标函数”（全文细节通常包括：用真实相邻步 logits 作为监督，最小化残差预测误差；以及可能的温度/归一化以匹配残差尺度），核心是让小模块学到跨步校正而不是重做 backbone。
summary.experiments: 在 SDAR 系列 DLM（1.7B/4B/8B）与 GSM8K 等基准上做测量与验证。关键现象实验：相邻步 logits 残差的 RMS 明显小于 logits 本身；并且随着一次解码的 token 数 k 增大，残差幅度上升但仍呈可预测结构（文中用 k=1..16 的对比来支撑）。系统集成到 SGLang 推理引擎。主要结果：在 speculative（lossless）模式下，对 SDAR 模型最高 1.42× 无损加速；direct 模式给出更好的质量-吞吐折中（相对阈值解码，在相同吞吐下质量更好，或相同质量下更快）。摘要里未给出更细的绝对指标（如 exact match/困惑度变化），精读实验部分可补齐。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看残差测量与动机图：理解“为什么残差小”以及它随 k 的变化规律，这是方法成立的前提。
- 再看 MRP 的训练目标与输入输出设计：它到底预测的是 logits 残差、log-prob 残差还是别的等价量；是否做了尺度归一化；以及模块容量多大。
- 重点看两种推理算法的差别：direct 的误差如何影响质量；speculative 的接受准则如何保证无损，以及在 DLM 去噪循环里如何对齐“下一步”。
- 最后看 SGLang 集成与端到端吞吐：确认加速来自减少 backbone 次数还是减少步数/更激进的 unmask 策略，并留意不同模型规模下收益是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: In masked/block diffusion LMs, decoding more tokens per denoising step improves throughput but typically hurts quality because tokens revealed in the same step are predicted without modeling their mutual dependencies. Running extra backbone passes would restore dependencies but kills the speed gains. The paper targets dependency-aware multi-token decoding with minimal additional backbone compute.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference-side contribution, but it addresses a key adoption blocker for diffusion-style LMs: making the quality–throughput tradeoff less punishing when increasing per-step parallelism. The pretraining-relevant insight is that adjacent denoising steps exhibit highly correlated logits, suggesting a learnable small-residual structure across time steps that could be exploited in future objectives or step-reduction training schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Multi-token Residual Prediction (MRP) leverages the empirical fact that the logit change between consecutive denoising steps is small when only a few tokens are unmasked. Define the inter-step residual δ_t = ℓ_{t-1} − ℓ_t. Since δ_t has much smaller magnitude than ℓ_t, predicting δ_t is an easier target.
At inference, one backbone forward produces ℓ_t and hidden states h_t; a lightweight MRP head predicts a correction term from h_t so that ℓ_{t-1} can be approximated as ℓ_t + MRP(h_t) without a second backbone pass. This enables decoding additional tokens “as if” the model had advanced one more denoising step.
Two modes:
- Direct decoding: use corrected logits directly for faster multi-token reveals, accepting some approximation error.
- Speculative decoding: treat MRP as a drafter and verify with the backbone on the next step; accepted tokens are intended to be lossless, shifting compute from expensive backbone passes to a cheap proposal mechanism.
Training uses a residual-focused objective supervised by true adjacent-step logits (details matter: scaling/normalization and what exact residual is predicted).
summary_en.experiments: Demonstrations are on SDAR diffusion models (1.7B/4B/8B) with analyses on GSM8K showing residual RMS is substantially smaller than raw logits, measured across effective step sizes k=1..16. Integrated into SGLang. Reported peak lossless (speculative) speedup is 1.42× on SDAR across multiple benchmarks; direct mode improves the quality–speed curve relative to threshold-based decoding at matched throughput. For exact task metrics and acceptance-rate breakdowns, the main experiments section is necessary.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim (~40 minutes): start with the residual characterization plots and measurement protocol; then read the MRP head definition and training loss carefully (what is predicted and how it’s scaled). Next, focus on the two inference algorithms—especially the speculative acceptance rule and how it is made compatible with the diffusion denoising loop. Finish with the SGLang integration and throughput breakdown to verify where the 1.42× comes from and how it scales with model size and k.

recommendation.zh: 核心洞察（相邻去噪步logit高度相似）简洁有效，是DLM推理加速的一个实用方向。建议重点阅读§3方法和§4.2的加速-质量权衡分析。
recommendation.en: The core insight (logits at adjacent diffusion steps are highly similar) is clean and effective for DLM inference acceleration. Focus on §3 method and §4.2 speed-quality tradeoff analysis.

paper.title: STS: Efficient Sparse Attention with Speculative Token Sparsity
paper.abstract: The quadratic complexity of attention imposes severe memory and computational bottlenecks on Large Language Model (LLM) inference. This challenge is particularly acute for emerging agentic applications that require processing multi-million token sequences. We propose STS, a sparse attention mechanism that requires no model retraining. STS leverages the key insight that tokens identified as important by a smaller draft model are highly predictive of important tokens for a larger target model. By

summary.core_problem: 论文解决长上下文推理中的注意力成本问题：全量 attention 需要为每个 query 扫描完整 KV cache，序列变长后受显存带宽和计算量限制。已有 token sparsity 方法通常依赖启发式选择重要 token，容易漏掉关键 token，或者用 block 级选择牺牲稀疏粒度，还会引入额外选择开销。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于推理效率，不是预训练方法。对基座研究的启发主要有两点。第一，小模型和大模型在同一输入上的 attention pattern 存在较强相关性，尤其是同系列模型；这说明跨尺度注意力结构有可迁移成分。第二，稀疏 attention 如果能保留完整 KV cache，只在当前 query 上动态稀疏，就比永久 token pruning 更适合长上下文和多轮 agent 场景。它也提示预训练阶段的长上下文稀疏化研究，不一定要从静态结构出发，可以利用 draft model 或辅助模型预测动态稀疏模式。
summary.technical_approach: STS 的核心做法是把 speculative decoding 中的小 draft model 复用为 token selector。draft model 正常生成候选 token，同时利用自己的 attention score 生成 token-and-head-wise sparsity mask。大 target model 不再做 dense attention，而是按照这个 mask 对每个 head、每个 query 只访问被认为重要的 token。方法不需要重新训练模型，也不丢弃 KV cache；所有历史 token 仍然保留，只是当前计算时按需读取。与传统 token pruning 不同，STS 避免了不可逆的信息删除；与即时生成 mask 的稀疏方法不同，mask 在 target model 执行前已经由 draft model 算好，因此选择开销可以和 speculative decoding pipeline 重叠，并可用于提前预取 KV 数据。论文还强调 STS 可用于 prefill 和 decode 两个阶段，而不是只优化 decode。
summary.experiments: 实现基于 vLLM，并集成到 speculative decoding 框架中。论文报告在代表性长文本 benchmark NarrativeQA 上，约 90% sparsity 下达到 2.67× speedup，同时相对 dense attention 的精度下降很小。与已有 token sparsity 方法相比，STS 在相同精度预算下能使用更高稀疏率，或在相同稀疏率下保持更好质量。实验还分析了 draft model attention 作为 target model token importance proxy 的有效性，以及“known-in-advance” mask 对 pipeline 和内存编排的好处。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Background，确认它与 linear attention、token pruning、传统 token sparsity 的边界。方法部分重点看 sparsity mask 如何从 draft model attention score 构造，以及 mask 的 token-wise、head-wise 粒度。实验部分优先看 NarrativeQA 上 90% sparsity、2.67× speedup 的设置，尤其要检查 batch size、上下文长度、draft/target 模型组合和精度指标。若时间有限，重点读 attention pattern correlation 的分析图和与已有稀疏方法的 accuracy-sparsity 曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the cost of full attention during long-context LLM inference. For every query, the target model scans the full KV cache, which becomes expensive in both compute and memory bandwidth. Existing token-sparsity methods often rely on heuristics, select coarse blocks instead of individual tokens, or add token-selection overhead that cancels part of the speed gain.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its main value for foundation-model research is the empirical observation that attention patterns transfer across model scales, especially within the same model family. It also makes a clear design choice: keep the full KV cache and sparsify only the current attention computation. That is safer than irreversible token dropping for long-context and multi-turn agent workloads. The idea may also inform future sparse-attention pretraining work, where a small auxiliary model or a draft model predicts dynamic sparsity rather than using fixed sparse layouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: STS reuses the draft model in speculative decoding as a token selector. The draft model still proposes candidate tokens, but its attention scores are also used to build a token- and head-wise sparsity mask. The target model then runs sparse attention according to this mask, avoiding dense attention over the full context. The method is training-free and preserves the full KV cache, so tokens that are unimportant for the current query are not permanently removed. A key systems property is that the mask is known before the target model executes. This lets the selection latency be hidden inside the speculative decoding pipeline and opens the door to proactive KV prefetching. Unlike many sparse methods that focus on decode only, STS is positioned for both prefill and decode.
summary_en.experiments: The authors implement STS in vLLM and integrate it with speculative decoding. On NarrativeQA, the paper reports a 2.67× speedup at roughly 90% sparsity with negligible accuracy loss relative to dense attention. Compared with prior token-sparsity techniques, STS shows a better accuracy-sparsity trade-off: for a fixed quality budget it can prune more attention work, and for a fixed sparsity level it preserves quality better. The experiments also analyze why draft-model attention is a useful proxy for target-model token importance and how the known-in-advance mask helps with pipeline scheduling and memory orchestration.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction and background to place STS relative to linear attention, token pruning, and heuristic token sparsity. In the method section, focus on how the draft attention scores are converted into token- and head-level masks. In the evaluation, check the exact NarrativeQA setting behind the 90% sparsity and 2.67× speedup, including context length, batch size, draft-target model pair, and quality metric. If time is limited, prioritize the attention-correlation analysis and the accuracy-sparsity comparison curves.

recommendation.zh: 无需重训练的稀疏注意力设计很巧妙，重点看掩码构造逻辑和速度-精度折衷实验部分。
recommendation.en: The no-retraining sparse attention design is clever, focus on the mask construction logic and speed-accuracy tradeoff experiments.

paper.title: BEAM: Binary Expert Activation Masking for Dynamic Routing in MoE
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enhance the efficiency of large language models by activating only a subset of experts per token. However, standard MoE employs a fixed Top-K routing strategy, leading to redundant computation and suboptimal inference latency. Existing acceleration methods either require costly retraining with architectural changes or suffer from severe performance drop at high sparsity due to train-inference mismatch. To address these limitations, we propose BEAM (Binary E

summary.core_problem: MoE模型传统固定Top-K路由不区分token复杂度，导致简单token产生冗余计算；现有动态路由方法要么存在专家选择、负载均衡、稀疏控制的梯度冲突，要么需要改动架构重训，或在高稀疏度下性能损失严重，无法兼顾训练兼容性、推理效率和模型效果。
summary.importance: 提出了解耦专家选择与稀疏控制的MoE动态路由思路，方案轻量可插拔，可直接用于MoE预训练后的推理优化，也可为训练阶段的动态稀疏路由设计提供依据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BEAM（二元专家激活掩码）框架，在原有主路由生成Top-K候选专家的基础上，新增一个轻量掩码路由，通过可训练二元掩码从Top-K候选中进一步裁剪冗余专家。用直通估计器（STE）传递二元掩码的梯度，辅以辅助正则损失鼓励稀疏。该设计解耦了主路由的专家选择、负载均衡功能与掩码路由的稀疏度控制功能，避免梯度冲突。BEAM可通过自定义CUDA内核集成到vLLM，仅需少量代码修改即可部署。
summary.experiments: 在高稀疏度下保留98%以上的模型性能，MoE层FLOPs最高减少85%，吞吐量提升1.4倍，解码速度提升2.5倍。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点：引言中对现有三类动态路由缺陷的分析、BEAM的解耦设计思路、实验部分的稀疏度-性能权衡结果。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Traditional fixed Top-K routing in MoE models ignores token-level complexity, causing redundant computation for simple tokens. Existing dynamic routing methods either suffer from gradient conflicts between expert selection, load balancing and sparsity control, require architectural changes and full retraining, or incur severe performance degradation at high sparsity, failing to balance training compatibility, inference efficiency and model quality.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a decoupled design for MoE dynamic routing that separates expert selection and sparsity control. The lightweight, plug-and-play solution can be directly applied to post-pretraining inference optimization of MoE models, and provides reference for dynamic sparse routing design during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes BEAM (Binary Expert Activation Masking), a dynamic routing framework that adds a lightweight mask router on top of the standard primary router. The primary router first generates Top-K candidate experts, then the mask router produces trainable binary masks to prune redundant experts from the candidate set. Gradients for the binary mask are propagated via the straight-through estimator (STE), with an auxiliary regularization loss to encourage sparsity. This design decouples the primary router's responsibilities of expert selection and load balancing from the mask router's sparsity control, eliminating gradient conflicts. BEAM can be integrated into vLLM with minimal code changes and a custom CUDA kernel for production deployment.
summary_en.experiments: Preserves over 98% of model performance at high sparsity, reduces MoE layer FLOPs by up to 85%, delivers 1.4× higher throughput and 2.5× faster decoding speed.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: focus on the introduction's analysis of limitations of three existing dynamic routing categories, BEAM's decoupled design, and the sparsity-performance tradeoff results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: MoE动态路由的新尝试，用二值掩码替代Top-K，关注其正则化损失设计和端到端训练的稳定性，对MoE架构优化有启发。
recommendation.en: A new attempt at dynamic routing in MoE, replacing Top-K with binary masks. Focus on its regularization loss design and end-to-end training stability, inspiring for MoE architecture optimization.

paper.title: XFP: Quality-Targeted Adaptive Codebook Quantization with Sparse Outlier Separation for LLM Inference
paper.abstract: We introduce XFP, a dynamic weight quantizer for LLM inference that inverts the conventional workflow: the operator specifies reconstruction quality floors on per-channel cosine similarity (one strict floor for attention and shared experts, one lazy floor for routed-expert MoE); XFP determines codebook size, outlier budget, and packing per layer automatically -- no Hessian, no calibration data, no manual bit-width selection. Each weight matrix is decomposed into a sparse fp16 outlier residual an

summary.core_problem: 解决现有LLM量化需要手动选择位宽、校准数据、Hessian计算，且无法按重构质量目标自适应配置的痛点
summary.importance: 提出了质量导向的端到端自适应量化框架，无需校准数据，属于推理量化领域的工程与方法创新
summary.technical_approach: XFP将权重分解为稀疏fp16离群残差与稠密子字节码本索引；用户指定注意力/共享专家、路由专家的余弦相似度质量下限，系统自动适配每层码本大小、离群预算、打包方式，支持两种存储模式与融合解码核
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3.5-122B-A10B上测试，单流解码速度达138 tok/s（RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell，TP=2），GSM8K严格匹配准确率94.49%，比Marlin INT4（TP=1）快49%

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the pain points of existing LLM quantization: manual bit-width selection, requirement for calibration data and Hessian calculation, and inability to adaptively configure based on reconstruction quality targets
summary_en.importance: Proposed a quality-oriented end-to-end adaptive quantization framework without calibration data, an engineering and methodological innovation in inference quantization
summary_en.technical_approach: XFP decomposes weight matrices into sparse fp16 outlier residuals and dense sub-byte index tensors into per-group learned codebooks; users specify cosine similarity quality floors for attention/shared experts and routed MoE experts, the system automatically adapts per-layer codebook size, outlier budget, and packing scheme, supporting two storage modes and fused decode kernels
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, achieving 138 tok/s single-stream decode speed (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, TP=2) with 94.49% GSM8K strict-match accuracy, 49% faster than Marlin INT4 at TP=1

recommendation.zh: 自适应量化的高实用性工程方案，无需校准数据的设计适配多种部署场景，重点看§3的码本自适应逻辑与性能对比表
recommendation.en: A highly practical adaptive quantization scheme without calibration data, focus on §3 codebook adaptation logic and performance comparison tables

paper.title: HASTE: Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration via Head-Wise Adaptive Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based video generation has advanced substantially in visual fidelity and temporal coherence, but practical deployment remains limited by the quadratic complexity of full attention. Training-free sparse attention is attractive because it accelerates pretrained models without retraining, yet existing online top-$p$ sparse attention still spends non-negligible cost on mask prediction and applies shared thresholds despite strong head-level heterogeneity. We show that these two overlooked f

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散模型中的全注意力计算随序列长度二次增长，已有 training-free 稀疏注意力仍把不少开销花在 mask 预测上，并且忽略不同 attention head 的稀疏性差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法。它不改变预训练目标或模型架构，但对 DiT / 视频生成模型的注意力稀疏化有工程参考价值，尤其是如何在不重训的前提下做 head-wise 预算分配。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HASTE，一个 head-wise adaptive sparse attention 框架。核心包括 Temporal Mask Reuse，根据 query-key drift 判断是否复用前一步稀疏 mask，减少在线 mask 预测成本；以及 Error-guided Budgeted Calibration，在全局稀疏预算下按 head 分配 top-p 阈值，使输出误差最小。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Wan2.1-1.3B 和 Wan2.1-14B 视频生成模型上进行，与 training-free online top-p sparse attention 类方法比较。摘要称在 XAttn 加速和质量保持之间取得更稳定的折中，但提供文本中未给出具体加速倍数、质量指标和显著性细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自厦门大学相关团队；给定信息中未能确认 Cohere 参与，按论文机构信息处理。

summary_en.core_problem: Full attention in video diffusion models has quadratic cost, while existing training-free sparse attention still spends nontrivial compute on mask prediction and uses shared thresholds despite strong head-level heterogeneity.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its useful part is the engineering treatment of sparse attention in Video DiTs, especially budget allocation across heads without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: HASTE introduces a head-wise adaptive sparse attention framework. Temporal Mask Reuse skips mask prediction when query-key drift is small, and Error-guided Budgeted Calibration assigns per-head top-p thresholds by minimizing measured output error under a global sparsity budget.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Wan2.1-1.3B and Wan2.1-14B. The abstract reports consistent improvements in the XAttention speed-quality trade-off over training-free top-p sparse attention baselines, but the provided text does not include exact latency, quality, or ablation numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Xiamen University. The provided metadata mentions Cohere, but the author-institution information does not confirm Cohere involvement.

recommendation.zh: 只看 calibration 和 mask reuse 的 ablation；对 LLM 预训练没有直接动作，但 head-wise 稀疏预算值得做类比。
recommendation.en: Read only the calibration and mask-reuse ablations; it does not change LLM pretraining practice, but the head-wise sparsity budgeting is a useful analogy.

paper.title: LEAP: Unlocking dLLM Parallelism via Lookahead Early-Convergence Token Detection
paper.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (dLLMs) have garnered significant attention for their potential in highly parallel processing. The parallel capabilities of existing dLLMs stem from the assumption of conditional independence at high confidence levels, which ensures negligible discrepancy between the marginal and joint distributions. However, the stringent confidence thresholds required to preserve accuracy severely constrain the scalability of parallelism. Through systematic token-level statistical ana

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散语言模型（dLLM）的置信度并行解码策略依赖高置信度令牌保证语义一致性，大量中置信度令牌实际已在去噪早期收敛到正确结果，但因未达到置信阈值无法提前解码，既限制了单步并行度，也降低了每步信息增量，最终拖慢整体推理速度。
summary.importance: 这一发现突破了dLLM并行解码的传统假设：高置信度并非令牌可安全解码的必要条件。LEAP作为无训练、即插即用的策略，为dLLM的速度-精度权衡提供了更优的帕累托边界，对扩散语言模型的推理优化和落地具有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: LEAP提出基于未来上下文扰动的收敛检测机制：1. 生成包含潜在未来信息的叠加上下文；2. 对比当前上下文与叠加上下文的预测结果，识别对未来更新敏感度低、预测结果稳定的中置信度令牌；3. 提前解码这类令牌，在不牺牲精度的前提下提升单步并行度与信息增量。该方法无需额外训练或微调，可直接嵌入现有dLLM解码流程。
summary.experiments: 在LLaDA和Dream两个开源dLLM上测试，覆盖数学推理、代码生成、多学科问答三类任务：LEAP相比置信度解码策略降低约30%推理延迟，同时在LLaDA上实现了平均精度的小幅提升；消融实验验证了未来上下文叠加与一致性检测是核心效果来源，二者共同构成了速度与精度的平衡优化。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读Introduction的token级统计分析部分，理解中置信度令牌的早期收敛特性；Methodology的收敛检测流程与扰动设计是核心创新；实验部分关注不同任务、不同模型上的速度-精度帕累托曲线对比，总阅读时间约25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing confidence-based parallel decoding strategies for diffusion language models (dLLMs) rely on high-confidence tokens to preserve semantic consistency. A large share of medium-confidence tokens actually converge to correct predictions early in the denoising process, but cannot be decoded in advance due to failure to meet confidence thresholds. This limits per-step parallelism, reduces information gain per iteration, and slows down overall inference speed.
summary_en.importance: This finding overturns the conventional assumption in dLLM parallel decoding: high confidence is not a necessary condition for safe token decoding. As a training-free, plug-and-play strategy, LEAP delivers a better Pareto frontier for the speed-accuracy tradeoff and provides direct guidance for inference optimization and deployment of diffusion language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: LEAP introduces a convergence detection mechanism based on future context perturbation: 1. Generate a superposed context containing potential future information; 2. Compare predictions from the current context and the superposed context to identify medium-confidence tokens with low sensitivity to future updates and stable predictions; 3. Decode these tokens in advance to improve per-step parallelism and information gain without accuracy loss. The method requires no additional training or fine-tuning and can be directly integrated into existing dLLM decoding pipelines.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on two open-source dLLMs, LLaDA and Dream, across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-disciplinary QA tasks: LEAP reduces inference latency by approximately 30% compared to confidence-based decoding, while achieving minor average accuracy improvements on LLaDA. Ablation studies confirm that future context superposition and consistency detection are the core sources of performance gain, together enabling balanced optimization of speed and accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the token-level statistical analysis in the Introduction to understand the early convergence property of medium-confidence tokens. The convergence detection workflow and perturbation design in Methodology are the core innovations. In the experiments section, pay attention to the speed-accuracy Pareto curve comparisons across different tasks and models. Estimated reading time: ~25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 dLLM 的可以看：它挑战了“高置信度才可并行”的默认判据；先读 token 统计分析和速度-质量曲线，若 setup 干净，这个解码 prior 该改。
